lokele: Liakoli lia Mboli Ilau ya Yesu Masiya, Wana wa Mungu.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

lokele: Kwa yatomoko nda lokasa loa Bɔtɔndɔli ako Yesaya, mbo— Tɛnɛ, itotoma wɛndi wami oso waɛ ndokakomya mboka yaɛ.
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, 1:2 I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you: Malachi 3:1

lokele: Limiki litoamama nda liɔmbɛlɛ mbo— Komyaka mboka ya Ngɛnɛ la longamesaka biëli yande.
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’” Isaiah 40:3

lokele: Yoane Bolufi ayaka nda liɔmbɛlɛ la anangolaka njasɔ ya lilufi lia lɔmɛsɛlɔmɔ loa njasɔ ibe ko eoka ya likalangani.
english: John came baptizing 1:4 in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

lokele: Bato batotina ba kenge ya Yudea la eba Yelusaleme bakuswaka ndokɛnɛ inde. Aoläkä iyo njasɔ ibe yau, balufiomökö lande nda liyande liko Yaladene.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

lokele: Yoane awataka esinda ya fuu ya ngamela, la bɔkɔli wa lokofo loa nyama nda lɔtɛta, la alakaka bakelele la wee wa lokonda.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

lokele: Inde lonangola mbo— Ɔmɔi atoya liili liami oyasoeta’mi la bofoka. Imi itiengane ndofomo isosha shotulama se ndofaikola ikulu sha tokwaka twande.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

lokele: Imi nd’asolufia ino nda balia kongoko Inde elufiaka ino la Bolimo Botanu. Lolufiomo loa Yesu
english: I baptized you in 1:8 water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

lokele: Nda becho ena Yesu losokwa nda Nasaleta ya Ngalilai, la Inde lolufiomo la Yoane nda Yaladene.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

lokele: Aeswaka Yesu nda balia, kwamao Inde lɔɛnɛ buse bosoatomo la Inde lɔɛnɛ Bolimo botoaa se kwa ekükü
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

lokele: la limiki lookana nda use mbo— Aɛ wende wana bosamomu wami. Aɛ nd’atoomalesa’mi finɛ.
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

lokele: Limɔ Bolimo lɔkɛsɛ Inde nda liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

lokele: Ayalaka nda liɔmbɛlɛ becho kama inɛi ani atososhelomo la Satana. Ayalanaka la nyama omao, la bakitomo lokukya Inde.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

lokele: Akandomökö Yoane nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ Yesu lɔkɛ nda Ngalilai ndokakambesa bato Mboli Ilau ya Mungu.
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

lokele: Inde mbo— Mbile esoengana, Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya tina, kalanganaka, imelaka Mboli Ilau. Lotomo lioi loa Baeki ba oso
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

lokele: Akɛndɛkɛ Yesu nda ngɔngɛ ya Eliya ya Ngalilai, Inde lɔɛnɛ Simona la Andelo, etungani yande ani batoluwa wɛngɔ eoka baaka baluwi ba swi.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Tütaka’mi la itoyales’ino baluwi ba bato.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

lokele: Lisasaya iyo lomacha wɛngɔ wau, iyo lotüta Inde.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

lokele: Akɛndɛkɛ Inde sumbu liasi, Inde lɔɛnɛ Yakobo wana wa Sebedayo la Yoane etungani yande, nda watɔ ani batowamba wɛngɔ wau.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

lokele: Kwamao Inde lot’iyo lioi la iyo lomacha sango wau la bakuwi bande nda watɔ, la iyo lotüta Inde. Kafenauma
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

lokele: Limɔ baɛkɛ nda Kafenauma. La nda lise lia Yenga Inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la Inde loekes’iyo.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

lokele: Iyo lomwaala liekesi liande finɛ eoka liekesi liande liaaka la isosha, inga kwa elia batikasa.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

lokele: Omao nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ aaka oto ɔmɔi la bolimo obe.
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

lokele: Inde loamama mbo— Iso laɛ, twende la loni loasɔ, Aɛ Yesu wa Nasaleta? Osoya oyasɛɛsɛlɛsɛ iso? Isoluwa Aɛ, wende oyo Botanu wa Mungu.
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

lokele: Yesu loima inde mbo— Yalaka tau, kuswaka ende inde.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

lokele: Bolimo obe lowanj’inde lokomba, wao loamama la limiki lifi, wao lokuswa ende inde.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

lokele: Batotina lomwaala, iyo lofelakana mbo— Ende to iye? ¿Mbo liekesi liyai-li? Ko la isosha atoima belimo ebe la yao kolitesa Inde.
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

lokele: Kwamao lokuku loande lofafana nda bekenge bitotina ebitimbi ya Ngalilai.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

lokele: Akuswaka Inde nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, iyo la eba Yakobo la Yoane, lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya Simona la Andelo.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

lokele: Nyango wa wali wa Simona aingalaka la etao nda bindo la lisasaya iyo lokambesa Yesu loasɔ loande.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

lokele: Yesu lɔkɛ ende otomali, Inde lound’inde bosamba, Inde loemes’inde la etao lomacha inde, la otomali lokuwel’iyo.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, 1:31 and she served them.

lokele: La likɔlɔse, ilaka buse litele, bato loesel’Inde eba kambo batotina la ebaaka la belimo ebe.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

lokele: Bato batoti ba okenge losɔngɔmɔ nda bome.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

lokele: Inde losäsola bato wike ba loo loa bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ la inde lokusola belimo wike. Inde lofekela belimo ndoonga eoka baluwaka Inde.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

lokele: Lanɔngɔ asiswaka la yombe, Inde lokuswa ndokakɛ nda elela eyetiaka la bato la Inde losombola omao.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

lokele: La Simona la ebaaka lande, iyo lotuta Yesu,
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

lokele: iyo loosha’Inde, iyo mbo— Bato batotina batoluk’Aɛ.
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Tɔɛkɛ konda bekenge yasi mbo ikookamelese mboli imɔ komao, eoka iyeli nde loao.
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

lokele: La Inde lɔkɛ okanangokole nda Ngalilai etotina nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la Inde lokusokola belimo ebe. Boto wa Baɛndi
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

lokele: Boto wa baɛndi loya oyasombokol’Inde, inde lokwa bakulusembe oso wande, inde mbo— Bɔlɛmbɛ, aɛ kokɔkɔlɔ ndotanesa’mi.
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

lokele: Yesu lookel’inde ngandi finɛ, Inde lonanola bosamba, inde lomata inde, Inde loonga lande mbo— Ilɛmbi nde ongoma; tanesomoko to.
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

lokele: Lisasaya baɛndi losekwa, inde lotanesomo.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

lokele: Yesu loima oto, Inde lotom’inde ani asoonga lande la boimo mbo— Okambesëke oto angomwitoto.
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ okatamba bindo yaɛ ende kanga la faefaka Mungu lifaefi kwa ataka Mɔsɛ ekela eoka ya lotaneso loaɛ, kwa ndembe ende bato.
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

lokele: Kongoko inde lɔkɛ, inde loakola ndokambesa bato la ndomelesa mboli ina, eokao Yesu angokɔkɔlɔ imɔ ndotɛmwa nda okenge. Inde loyalaka nda liɔmbɛlɛ, la iyo lokaeshakane end’Inde nda fangi bitotina.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

lokele: Mbisa ya becho bimɔi, Inde loinwa nda Kafenauma liasi la mboli lookana mbo ale nda ndakɔ.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

lokele: Bato wike losɔngɔmɔ, eokao angwɛnɛ elela ango nda bome. Anangoelaka’iyo wɛndi.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

lokele: Lamao iyo loyaeshel’Inde oto wa lonyango oyatolomoko la bato banɛi.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

lokele: Batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndoya tina lande eoka ya bokamu, eokao iyo lofandola losambɔ loa ndakɔ olo ayalaka Yesu. Afindolaka iyo losambɔ, iyo losulola tange eyaingaelaka boto wa lonyango.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Yesu liimeli liau Inde loonga la boto wa lonyango mbo— Wana, njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɛlɔmɔ.
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

lokele: Batikasa bamɔi bayalaka se omao, iyo lota fee nda betema mbo—
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

lokele: ¿Monito boto-yo asoonga ani? Asosɛɔlɔ Mungu. Ndai atokɔkɔlɔ ndomɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ibe sakolo ko Mungu angɛnɛ?
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

lokele: Limɔ, aluwaka Yesu nda botema wande mbo basotana fee ongoma, Inde loonga lau mbo— Osota fee nda betema yanu eoka ya njasɔ-bi monito?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

lokele: Loni losoeta la ɔlɛmbu, kwa ndoonga la oto wa lonyango mbo— Njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɛlɔmɔ; kwa ndoonga lande mbo— Emalaka, ilaka tange yaɛ, la tangwaka?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

lokele: Kongo ko mbo boluweke mbo Wana wa Boto ende la isosha shomɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ibe ono se, Inde loonga la oto wa lonyango mbo—
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins” —he said to the paralytic—

lokele: Itoonga laɛ, Emalaka, ilaka tange yaɛ, kɛndɛkɛ nda ndakɔ yaɛ.
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

lokele: Inde loemala lisasaya, inde loila tange yande, inde lokuswa oso wa batotina la iyo lomwaala, iyo loinela Mungu. Iyo mbo— Oso tokɛni ani. Lotomo-lioi lia Lewi
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ liasi nda ngɔngɛ ya liyande la bitanda ya bato losɔngɔmɛlɛ Inde la Inde loekes’iyo.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

lokele: Etaka Inde nda mboka Yesu lɔɛnɛ Lewi, wana wa Alafaya ani ayalaka nda ɛsɔnjɛlɔ ya bɔsɔmbi, la Inde loonga lande mbo— Tutaka’mi. Inde loemala la inde lotuta Yesu.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

lokele: Lamao ayalaka Yesu nda mɛsa nda ndakɔ ya Lewi, amamwito la baeki bande, bɛsɔmbɛsi la bato ba njasɔ ibe bayalaka se lau, eoka baaka wike ebatutak’Inde.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ Batikasa la BaFalusi ani atolaka bieka amamwito la bato abe la bɛsɔmbɛsi, iyo loonga la baeki bande mbo— ¿Atola bieka amamwito la bɛsɔmbɛsi la bato abe eoka iye?
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

lokele: Okaka Yesu ongoma Inde loonga lau mbo— Ebale la bosasu baitolüka bonganga, kangä eba kambo. Imi itiye oyata eba liengani lioi, kangä bato ba njasɔ ibe.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

lokele: Baeki ba Yoane la BaFalusi bakilaka bieka, limɔ bato loya la iyo lofela Yesu mbo— ¿Baeki ba Yoane la eba BaFalusi imɔ batokilaka bieka, kongo ko baeki baɛ batikile eoka iye?
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Atoyala tolesani amamwito la oyatosɔngɔ, batokɔkɔlɔ ndokila bieka? Atoyala bɔsɔngi amamwito lau, baitokɔkɔlɔ ndokila bieka.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

lokele: Nde bacho beyaka ani bɔsɔngi atoɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’iyo, limɔ nda lise lina iyo kokila bieka.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

lokele: Boto aitowamba esinda ya liɔmbɔ la yaki ya esinda eyai, eoka mbamba ya esinda eyai etosalaka esinda ya liɔmbɔ, limɔ lifola litofalwa.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

lokele: Boto aitoangola bänä bayai nda biuku ebisoumwa eoka mbo bänä bataata biuku, limɔ bänä batowɛlɛkɛmɛ se, la bao la biuku imɔ kowa. Bänä bayai batowɛlɔmɔ nda biuku biyai. Lise lia Yenga
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

lokele: Etaka Yesu la lise lia Yenga nda bilanga ya bangwindi, baeki bande loakola ndotwa bangwindi ani batokɛndɛ.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

lokele: Limɔ BaFalusi loonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛngɔ, basotefola liti lia Yenga monito?
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Okatangi nde lona eloakelaka Dawidi, inde la ebaaka lande, nda lise eliayalaka iyo la boeno la isiye—
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

lokele: mbo inde lɔɔtɛlɛ ndakɔ ya Mungu, nda mbile ya Abiatala Kanga-eyeti, inde lola lituma eliatambomökö nda mɛsa ya Mungu, elitiaaka liolaka sakolo ko la kanga angɛnɛ, inde lofaefa ebayalaka amamwito lande?
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

lokele: La Yesu loonga lau mbo— Lise lia Yenga liakelomökö eoka ya bato; bato batiakelomökö eoka ya Yenga,
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

lokele: ongoma Wana-wa-Boto nd’ayali Bɔkɔta wa Yenga.
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

lokele: Lise liasi Inde lɔɔtɔ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la boto aaka omao la bosamba bɔlɛmbɛti.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

lokele: Iyo lolamba Yesu eluwa atouwes’inde la lise lia Yenga, mbo bawanjeleke Inde.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga la boto wa bosamba bɔlɛmbɛti, Inde mbo— Emalaka, yauku l’ono nd’atiteni.
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Loni losoengana la Yenga, ndokela olau, kwa ndokela obe? ¿Kwa ndouwesa oto kwa ndoola oto?
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

lokele: Kongo ko iyo loyala hai, Yesu lɔmwɛlɛ iyo la botema wale, inde looka ngandi eoka ya betema yau bewau. Inde loonga la boto mbo— Nanolaka bosamba waɛ. Inde lonanola wao la wao luwa kwa ebɔmɔi.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

lokele: Limɔ BaFalusi lokuswa, iyo lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ amamwito l’eba Helodi mbo bɛnɛkɛ mboka yool’Inde.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

lokele: Nde Yesu la baeki bande losekwa, iyo lɔkɛ fangi ya eliya. Wike wa bato lotutak’Inde, l’eba Ngalilai, l’eba Yudea, l’eba Yelusaleme, l’eba Idumea, l’eba fangi yasi ya Yaledene, l’eba yese ya Tuloa la Sidona,
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

lokele: okakä iyo mboli ya bitotina ebiakelaka Inde, iyo loya ende Yesu.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

lokele: Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo batonjelek’Inde watɔ woumbakel’Inde eoka ya bokamu wa bato, mbo batawamak’Inde.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

lokele: Eoka Inde louwekesa wike la bato lolingel’Inde la bokamu mbo eba ngwo bamateke Inde.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

lokele: La ɛnɛkɛ belimo ebe wɛnɛ Yesu, iyo lotulamel’Inde se, iyo loamama mbo— Aɛ wende Wana wa Mungu.
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

lokele: Nde Inde loim’iyo mbo bataluwesa bato loasɔ loande. Baeki bande liu la ambale
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ olikolo lia löngo, lamao Inde lota ebalɛmbɛk’Inde lioi la iyo ana loyel’Inde.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

lokele: la Inde lofa bato liu la ambale isosha mbo bayalakeke lande la mbo atomakek’iyo ndokakambesa wɛndi,
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

lokele: la ndokusola belimo ebe.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

lokele: Inde lota eba liu la ambale, bako Simona (Yesu lot’inde lina mbo Petelo)
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

lokele: la Yakobo wana wa Sebedayo, la Yoane etungani yande (Yesu atak’iyo ambale lina liko Boanegesi, litina mbo Bana ba kaki)
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

lokele: la Andelo la Filipo, Balatomayo, la Matayo, Toma, la Yakobo wana wa Alufayo, la Tadayo, la Simona wa Kanana,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

lokele: la Yudasi wa Keliota, oyawambaka Yesu. Limɔ iyo loinwa nda ndakɔ,
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

lokele: la bokamu wa bato losɔngɔmɔ liasi l’ani iyo angokɔkɔlɔ ango ndola bieka.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

lokele: Okaka bato bande ongoma, iyo loya mbo baundek’Inde; iyo mbo— Asowa loseka.
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

lokele: Limɔ batikasa ebasokwaka nda Yelusaleme iyo loonga mbo— Asɔɔtɛlɔmɔ la Balasebula, la atokusola beimo ebe ko la lisungi lia bokɔta wa belimo ebe. Satana la Yesu angosunganaka
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lot’iyo lioi la Inde loonga lau la bembila, Inde mbo— ¿Satana atokɔkɔlɔ ndokusola Satana monito?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

lokele: Eyambo bokenge bosoatana bonanakeke limɔ wao boitokɔkɔmɔ.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

lokele: Eyambo bofindi bosoatana ongoma, wao imɔ angokɔkomɔ.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

lokele: Satana imɔ enana lande angɛnɛ, ani bofoka wande bosoatana aitokokɔmɔ, asosila fɛɛ.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

lokele: Eoka boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya bowangɔ mbo aindeke yeka yande, sakolo ko atotakanda bowangɔ, lamao inde koindaka ndakɔ yande.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

lokele: Ongoma isoonga lanu wewe mbo— Njasɔ ibe bitotina bitomɛsɔlɔmo la basɛɔli batotina ba bato imɔ,
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

lokele: sakolo ngo ko oyatosɛɔlɔ Bolimo Botanu atiaolɛkɛ limɛsɛli, bobe wande bolayalaka layalaya.
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.” 3:29

lokele: Inde ongoma eoka bato mbo— Ale la bolimo obe.
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

lokele: Limɔ nyango la bitungani yande loya, iyo loemesana lousa loa ndakɔ ani basotoma wɛndi end’Inde ot’Inde lioi.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

lokele: La windi wa bato lolingel’Inde, iyo mbo— Tɛnɛ, nyango waɛ la bitungani yaɛ bale lousa la batolük’Aɛ.
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters 3:32 are outside looking for you.”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Nyango wami ndai? ¿Bitungani yami yende ndai?
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lɔɛlɛlɛ bato ebayalaka se tina lande, Inde mbo— Tɛnɛ nyango wami la bitungani yami. Inde oyatokela kwa alɛmbi Mungu, inde nd’ale etungani yami la welo wami la nyango wami.
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

lokele: Yesu loakola liasi ndoekesa bato nda ngɔngɛ ya eliya, la windi wa bato lolingel’Inde woeta ewa oso, eokao Inde lokwa nda watɔ, Inde loyala se nda watɔ ani bato loyala nda ngɔngɛ.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

lokele: Inde loekes’iyo njasɔ wike kola bembila. Nda liekesi liande Inde loonga lau mbo— Toka kɔni, bɔlɔi lokalɔɔ koto;
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

lokele: alɔɔkɔ inde koto ongoma, bimɔi lokwa nda mboka, la nɔli loya oyala yao,
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds 4:4 came and devoured it.

lokele: la yasi bimɔi lokwa nda elela olo ayali batalɛ, angwɛnɛ nyɛlɛ wike, yao lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ lisasaya eoka ya nyɛlɛ yotalangu.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

lokele: Nde ayaka löwa ifitika, yao lobɛɛlɛ la njöwa, yao lobɛɛkɛlɛ fee eoka angwɛnɛ biili.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

lokele: La yasi bimɔi lokwa nda kɛ̈kɛ̈ limɔ kɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ la kɛ̈kɛ̈ lonyɛlɛ koto, yao angota tuma.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

lokele: Yasi bimɔi lokwa nda nyɛlɛ ilau, yao lɔɔ̈tɔ̈, yao lota tuma wike, bimɔi kama isatɔ, bimɔi kama liambɛ, bimɔi kama liu.
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

lokele: Inde loonga mbo— Oyale la batoi booka, okeke.
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

lokele: Ayalaka Yesu la baeki bande liu la ambale, iyo angɛnɛ, ebaaka lau lofel’Inde loasɔ loa bombila-bo.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Ende ino kongo njasɔ ebisoisomo ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, yao koisolomo; kongo ko ende ebale lousa loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, bitotina bitokambesomo kola bembila, mbo
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

lokele: bɛnɛkɛ nde la baiso ko liɛnɛlɛ, la mbo bokeke liokela, angoluwa litina mbo batakalangana la mbo batamɛselɔmɔ.
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’” Isaiah 6:9-10

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Otiluwe nde litina lia bombila-bo? Otoluwa to batina ba bembila yasi moni?
english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

lokele: Bɔlɔi atolɔɔ lioi (lia Mungu)
english: The farmer sows the word.

lokele: bato bamɔi bale kwa mboka eyalɔɔmɔkɔ lioi, limɔ atook’iyo, lisasaya Satana atoyasokola lioi elisolɔmɔ end’iyo.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

lokele: Ongoma bamɔi bende kwa elela ya batalɛ eyalɔɔmɔkɔ koto, atook’iyo lioi batoaola lisasaya la limɛngɔ
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

lokele: kongo ko bati la biili ndatiteni yau, batoumwa ko mbile sinyo, limɔ atoya tale la likongolomu eoka ya Lioi, lisasaya batokwa se.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

lokele: Basi bale kwa ebasolɔɔmɔ nda kɛ̈kɛ̈, batooka Lioi
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

lokele: nde bifembi ya wenda la lilimbi lia bieto la yɛmɛ ya yeka yasi, bitoyanyɛɛlɛ Lioi, liao angota tuma.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

lokele: La ebamɔi bende ebalɔɔmɔkɔ nda nyɛlɛ ilau, iyo batooka Lioi, batota tuma; bamɔi kama isatɔ, bamɔi kama liambɛ, bamɔi kama liu.
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Paka etɔɔsɔmɔ eoka ndosɛlɔmɔ ose ya ɛɛngɔ kwa ose ya tange? ¿Eti mbo esɛlɔmɔkɔ nda yɛnɛsɛlo?
english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket 4:21 or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

lokele: Ongoma angwɛnɛ yeka eyaisami sakolo ko ndoisolomo, angwɛnɛ loasɔ eloisomuku sakolo ko ndoyenɛlɛ fololo.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

lokele: Boto eyala la batoi booka, okeke.
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

lokele: Nde Inde loonga lau mbo— Enyelaka la wɛli yao ebitook’ino, ikwelo esitokwel’ino, ongoma sitokwelomo lanu; la botalia botaliomoko end’ino.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

lokele: Eoka end’inde oyale la yeka, efomoko nde inde; nde oyati la yeka, yao eyale lande kɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’inde. Bɔɔ̈tɛli wa lioi lia Mungu
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

lokele: Inde loonga mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bole kwa mbo oto atolɔɔ koto nda nyɛlɛ,
english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

lokele: limɔ atoingala la atosiswa, la ocho la löwa, ani koto bitoɔ̈tɔ̈ la bitokonda, inde angolüwa bɔɔ̈tɛlɔ,
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

lokele: nyɛlɛ etɔɔ̈tɛkɛsɛ yao angɛnɛ koto, litɔmbɔ oso, limɔ lififa, limɔ bongenge wa bangwindi.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

lokele: Nde atotela bangwindi, lisasaya ngɛnɛ kotoma oto la kɛmbɛ, eoka eula esoya.
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Totokwela Bokɔta wa Mungu la boni bɔfɔnɔ? la tototela wao la boni bombila?
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

lokele: Bole kwa lokoto loa mbase elosolɔɔmɔ nda nyɛlɛ. Lole lokoto lokɛkɛ, loeti bitoti la bɔkɛkɛ.
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

lokele: kongo ko atokonda loao, lotolongela tosasandu tototina la lotota beta la nɔli bitɔkɔkɔlɔ okela bikalingo yau nda liyɔmbɛ lia loao.
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

lokele: Kola bembila wike, kwa ebi ebisokɔkɔlɔ iyo ndooka litina, Yesu loonga lau Lioi,
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

lokele: la Inde angoonga lau sakolo ko la bombila. Inde loluwesa baeki bande angɛnɛ litina ko iyo angɛnɛ kongo. Yesu lɔɔngɛsɛ lomba nda eliya
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

lokele: Lise-ao, ilaka buse litele, Yesu loonga lau mbo— Tolekeke nda boili wasi.
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

lokele: la iyo losenyana la windi wa bato, la baeki lɔkɛ lande, kwa ayali Inde nda watɔ. Biatɔ yasi lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande,
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

lokele: la lomba lofi loa lofofo loya la batutu loomakana nda watɔ, wao wasiakaotuma la balia.
english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

lokele: Inde angɛnɛ loyala nda wendo ani aingalaka ilɔ nda liongaotö; iyo losisɔlɔ Yesu, iyo mbo— Boekesi, atowa iso ani, Aɛ angookel’iso ngandi?
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

lokele: Inde loemala, inde loima fofo, Inde loonga la balia mbo— Latemaka, yalaka hai. La lomba lotemba tembelele, la loao lolatema late.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Owängiki ani monito? Okayali nde la lilendelu?
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

lokele: Kongo ko iyo lowänga la bɔwa finɛ, iyo loongana mbo— Ende to ndai, eoka la lomba la balia bitolitesa lioi liande?
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

lokele: Iyo loiya nda boili wasi wa eliya, boko yese ya BaKelasene.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

lokele: La asaowaka Yesu nda watɔ, lisasaya boto oyayalaka la bolimo obe inde lokuswa nda fowa biko sai oyatowana la Yesu.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

lokele: Boto ona aaka la eyaelo yande omao nda fowa biko sai. Angwɛnɛ boto ango ɔmɔi kokɔkɔlɔ okand’inde la bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

lokele: Akandomökö nde oso bakandomo wike kola bakala la bɛnyɔlɔlɔ, kongo ko inde lɔɔ̈mɔlɔ bɛnyɔlɔlɔ fɔi la bakala inde lotenakaka batena wike; angwɛnɛ oto oyale la bofoka wokakales’inde.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

lokele: Becho betoti, la ocho la löwa inde loyalaka nda sai la nda föngo, ani inde loamamaka inde lotinyaka lokomba loande la batalɛ.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ inde wɛnɛ Yesu esika, inde lofata mangu okatulamel’Inde se;
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

lokele: inde loaamama la limiki lifi mbo— ¿Iso laɛ twende la loni loasɔ, Aɛ Yesu wana wa Mungu Oyalongeli? Itoomb’Aɛ la lina lia Mungu mbo wokesëke’mi bïale.
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

lokele: Eoka Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kuswaka ende oto-yo, aɛ bolimo obe.
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

lokele: Yesu lofel’inde mbo— Lina liaɛ liko ndai? Inde lomutola mbo— Lina liami liko Legione eoka tole bokamu (wa belimo)
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

lokele: la inde lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Yesu finɛ mbo atasayëk’iyo nda yese-ye.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

lokele: Omao nda fangi ya löngo yaaka liyasa lifi lia ndei ani bitolaka bieka;
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

lokele: belimo losombola Inde mbo— Kɛsɛk’iso nda ndei ina mbo toɔtɛlɛkɛ yao.
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

lokele: La Yesu lomachel’iyo la belimo ebe lokuswela oto, yao lɔɔtɛlɛ ndei la liyasa lia ndei lokwa mangu kola löngo konda eliya la yao lowa nda balia, loketi loa yao mbo bilɛfu imbale.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

lokele: Limɔ betingani ya ndei lofata mangu ndokakambesa mboli nda bekenge la nda bilanga limɔ bato loya oyɛnɛ lona eloakelomoko.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

lokele: Ayaka iyo ende Yesu, iyo lɔɛnɛ boto oyaiki la belimo ani ayali se, la awati esinda la ani ati’mɔ la loseka, ako boto oyaaka la Legione (bokamu wa belimo). Iyo lowänga finɛ.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

lokele: Bato ebɛnɛkɛ loasɔ loluwes’iyo loasɔ loa boto wa belimo la eloa ndei;
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

lokele: iyo loakola ndosombola Yesu mbo asekweke nda yese yau.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

lokele: Akwaka Yesu nda watɔ, boto oyaaka la belimo lofela Yesu mbo ayaleke lande.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

lokele: kongo ko Yesu atiakuliaka, nde Inde loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda ndakɔ ende ebaɛ la kangesak’iyo ebifi ebisokeela Mungu ende aɛ la ngandi eyesookel’Inde aɛ.
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

lokele: La oto lɔkɛ eyande, inde loakola ndomelesa mboli nda Ndekapoli ya njasɔ bifi ebiakelaka Yesu ende inde, la batotina lomwaakala. Wana otomali wa Yailo
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

lokele: Alekaka Yesu la watɔ konda boili wasi, windi wa bato lɔsɔngɔmɛlɛ Inde ani ayali nda ngɔngɛ.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

lokele: La ɔmɔi wa bekumi ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ loya, lina liande liko Yailo, ɛnɛkɛ inde ɔɛnɛ Yesu inde lokwa balui se,
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

lokele: inde losombola Inde finɛ, mbo— Wana otomali wami ɔkɛkɛ asoya oko tina lowa, Yauku oyatalia inde osamba waɛ mbo uweke la mbo aikeke imɔ.
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

lokele: Yesu lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande, la windi wa bato lotutak’inde, iyo lowamakana lande.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

lokele: Bɔtɔmali ɔmɔi aaka omao oyaaka la lokambo loa likila ko miaka liu la imbale;
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

lokele: okäkä wäle finɛ ende kanga wike, la asilesaka bieto yande bitoti, angosäsa ango sinyo, lokambo lɔkɛ la oso.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

lokele: Okäkä inde lokuku loa Yesu, otomali loya nda windi wa bato ombisa ya Yesu, inde lomata esinda yande,
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

lokele: eoka aongaka mbo— Yemata ango bisinda yande, imi kouwesomo.
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

lokele: Lisasaya likila löma tɔu la otomali looka nda lokomba mbo asosäsa loo loande.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

lokele: Yesu imɔ looka mbo bofoka bouwesa oto bosokuswel’Inde, Inde lokikwa nda bokamu, Inde mbo— Ndai amatiki bisinda yami?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

lokele: La baeki bande loonga lande mbo— Osɔɛnɛ bokamu wa bato basowamaka’Aɛ, nde kofela mbo— Ndai amatiki’mi?
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loɛlɛlɛ, mbo ɛnɛkɛ oyasokela ongoma.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

lokele: Botomali lowänga, inde lonyanga finɛ, eoka aluwi loao elosokelomo end’inde, otomali loya oyakwa se oso wa Yesu la inde loluwesa Yesu bitotina wewe.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wana otomali, liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ, kɛndɛkɛ la lilatemi la säsesomoko lokambo loaɛ.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

lokele: Atitasilaka Inde ndoonga, bato ebasekwaka nda ndakɔ ya Bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ loya oyaonga lande mbo— Wana otomali waɛ asowa; ¿Otookesa Boekesi likati imɔ monito?
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

lokele: Nde Yesu looka lioi elisoongomo, kongo ko Inde loonga la Bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ mbo— Owangëke, imelaka kongo.
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

lokele: Yesu atiakuliaka oto angomwito mbo atutaneke lande, sakolo ko Petelo la Yakobo la Yoane, etungani ya Yakobo.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

lokele: Iyaka iyo nda ndakɔ ya Bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ Inde lɔɛnɛ limbilititi lia bato la etondo efi ya bato ebatolelaka finɛ.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

lokele: Aɔtɔkɔ Inde, Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Otokela etondo la otolelalela monito? Wana atikwele se, aingali ilɔ.
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo losɛkɛlɛ Inde finɛ. Inde lumes’iyo atotina lousa, limɔ Inde lɔɔsɔ la sango la nyango ba wana la ebaaka lande angɛnɛ Inde lɔɔtɔ olo aingali wana.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

lokele: Aundaka Inde wana bosamba, Inde loonga lande mbo— Talita kumi; litina mbo— Wanaotomali, Imi mbo, Emalaka.
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

lokele: Kwaamao wanaotomali loemala, inde lɔkɛndɛ, aaka nde la miaka liu la imbale. Bato losisimwa finɛ.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lotel’iyo ekela mbo bataluwesa oto angomwito, limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo bafeke wanaotomali bieka yola.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

lokele: Inde losekwa omao; Inde loya nda tukela yande angɛnɛ la baeki bande lotut’Inde.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

lokele: Nda lise lia Yenga Inde loakola ndoekesa bato nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ Okak’iyo likambesi liande, bato wike lomwaala, iyo mbo— Boto-yo asɔɔlɔ to liao anima? Boni wɛlï bosofomo boto-yo? Bisisho ya bofoka ebitokelomo la besamba yande yende la litina moni?
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

lokele: ¿Ati nde bɔkwɛti-yo, wana wa Malia, boloo wa Yakobo la Yose, la Yuda la Simona? ¿Baelo bande bati to eya lasu? La iyo lɔɛnɛ tale eoka yande.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Bɔtɔndɔli atolitesomoko sakolo ngo ko nda bokenge wande angɛnɛ la nda bokulu wande la nda ndakɔ yande angɛnɛ.
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

lokele: Atiakɔkɔlɔkɔ okela bisisho ya bofoka omao sakolo ko mbo ataliaka besamba yande ende ebakambo bamɔi la auwesaka’iyo.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

lokele: Inde lomwaala eoka batiaaka la liimeli. Limɔ Inde lɔkɛ nda kenge bikɛkɛ bitimbi okaekekesa bato omao. Lɔkɛndɔ loa Baeki liu la Ambale
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

lokele: Inde lota baeki liu la ambale lioi; Inde loakola ndotom’iyo, bambale bambale, la Inde lof’iyo isosha likolo lia belimo ebe.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

lokele: Inde lofekel’iyo ndotola yeka ya mboka, sakolo ko itumbe kongo, inga lituma, inga litanga, inga bieto,
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

lokele: kangä bawateke tokwaka nde Inde lofekel’iyo owata kanju imbale.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Olo atɔɔtɔ ino nda ndakɔ, yalaka kw’amao kond’akakusweke ino nda okenge ona;
english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

lokele: la olo atofeka bato ndonyangel’ino la ndok’ino, akasokwek’ino omao, fufolaka liunge elisowatema la batindi banu kwa ndembe ende iyo.
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

lokele: Baeki lɔkɛ, iyo lotaka boeki mbo bato bakalanganeke,
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

lokele: iyo lokusokola belimo ebe wike, iyo lɔlɔkɛsɛ eba kambo baita, iyo losäsa. Liwa lia Yoane Bolufi
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

lokele: Bɔkɔta Helodi (Antipas) looka loasɔ-lo eoka lokuku loa lina lia Yesu lookana finɛ, la bamɔi mbo Yoane asokuswa nda liwa eokao befoka bitokelaka bisisho ko lande.
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

lokele: Basi mbo Ende Eliya, la basi mbo Ende Bɔtɔndɔli kwa bɔfɔnɔ w’eba oso.
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

lokele: Okaka nde Helodi ongoma inde loonga mbo— Oyatinyaka’mi kingo ako Yoane, end’inde asokuswa nda liwa.
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

lokele: Eoka mbo Helodi atomaka bato okaundesa Yoane, inde lot’inde nda ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, loasɔ loa Helodia ako wali wa boloo wande ako Filipo, eoka Helodi asɔngɔkɔ inde.
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

lokele: Yoane aongaka lande mbo— Etiengane la bikela mbo ɔɔsɛkɛ wali wa bolo waɛ.
english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

lokele: Ko ani Helodia loisel’inde ikufya mbo aolek’inde, kongo ko inde angokɔkɔlɔ,
english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

lokele: eoka Helodi angɛnɛ lowänga Yoane la aluwaka mbo ende oto wa liengani la ewa Mungu; ongoma Helodi lotingana lande. Okaka Helodi inango shande, botema wande lokwelo liyɛyɛ, nde inde look’inde la limɛngɔ.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

lokele: Nde yose eyengani loya, Helodi nda lise lioenyela liotomu liande, inde lokenja elambɔ ende bafoka la benyafala yande la betolioso ya Ngalilai.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

lokele: Boseka wa Helodia lɔɔtɔ nda elambɔ, inde loinel’iyo isha, inde loomalesa Helodi la ebayalaka lande. Limɔ Bɔkɔta Helodi longa la boseka mbo— Felaka’mi yeka eyekalɛmbɛkɛ aɛ, yefak’aɛ yao.
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

lokele: Helodi lotel’inde tele mbo— Yeka eyetofel’aɛ, yefak’aɛ yao, ango yaki ya bɔkɔta wami.
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

lokele: Limɔ boseka lokuswa okaonga la nyangɔ wande mbo— ¿Ifelek’iye? La nyango mbo— Botö wa Yoane Bolufi.
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

lokele: Inde loinywa la mangu ende Bɔkɔta, inde lofel’inde mbo— Ilɛmbi nde mbo ofeke’mi ko kwanikwani, botö wa Yoane Bolufi nda lotufa.
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

lokele: Helodi looka ikɛnɛnɛ sifi, kongo ko eoka ya tele yande la eoka ya ebayalaka lande, inde angolɛmbɛ ndotombola lisakä liande.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

lokele: Bɔkɔta lotoma bosilikani ɔmɔi mbo aesheke botö wande. Inde lɔkɛ, inde lotenel’inde kingo nda ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ,
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

lokele: inde loesha botö nda lotufa, inde lofa boseka wao, la boseka lɔkɛ okafa nyango wande.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

lokele: Okaka baeki bande ongoma, iyo loya, iyo loila engulunguma, iyo loomba yao nda losai. Lilesi lia Bato Bilɛfu bɔɔmwi
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

lokele: Ainwaka batomomu ende Yesu, iyo loluwes’Inde bitotina ebiakelaka iyo la ebiaekesaka iyo.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Yauku, ko ino angɛnɛ konda elela eyele elämbä, ndoyaeuma sumbu. Eoka bato wike loetaetaka la iyo batiɛnɛkɛ ango fofe yola bieka.
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lɔkɛ la watɔ konda elela eyaaka elämbä ko iyo angɛnɛ.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

lokele: Kongo ko bato loɛnɛ iyo la lolembeel’iyo; bato ba kenge bitoti lokwa mangu la boili, iyo loetelel’iyo oso.
english: They 6:33 saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

lokele: Asaowaka Yesu, Inde loɛnɛ windi bofi wa bato, la Inde lookel’iyo ngandi, eoka baaka kwa bɛkɔkɔ ebiti la botingani; la Inde loakola ndoekes’iyo njasɔ wike.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

lokele: Aɔngɔkɔ buse litele, baeki bande loyaonga lande mbo— Elela-ye ende ko isimo la buse bosɔɔngɔ.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

lokele: Machak’iyo baɛkɛ nda bilanga la bekenge bitimbi okasomba bieka yola.
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ino angɛnɛ faefak’iyo bieka yola. Iyo mbo— Tɔɛkɛ nde okasomba beila la falanga mia imbale mbo tofaef’iyo bieka yola?
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii 6:37 worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Ole la beila yanga? Kɛndɛkɛ okɛnɛ. Limɔ aluwak’iyo, iyo lomutola mbo— Bɔɔmwi la swi imbale.
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo bayalesɛk’ato batotina se nda twingi twesi, botuka la botuka;
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

lokele: iyo loyalaka se, ebotuka mia, mia; ebotuka kama bɔɔmwi, kama bɔɔmwi.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

lokele: Inde lɔɔsɔ beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale, Inde loila baiso likolo, Inde losombola limɔ Inde loataka beila. Inde lofaekefa baeki bande mbo basɛlɛkɛ yao oso wa bato; la swi imbale imɔ. Inde lokaela yao ende batotina.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

lokele: Batotina lola la iyo lokanelo.
english: They all ate and were filled.

lokele: Iyo loina twinyo twa beila totumesa bisaka liu la imbale la twinyo twa swi lisanga.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

lokele: Bato ana ebalaka beila baaka batolome bilɛfu bɔɔmwi. Yesu lotanda likolo lia balia
english: Those who ate the loaves were 6:44 five thousand men.

lokele: Kwaamao Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo bakweke nda watɔ la mbo balekeke oso wande ko nda boili wasi nda Betesaida, ani Inde atomelesa bato.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

lokele: Asenyanak’Inde la bato, Yesu lɔkɛ nda löngo okasombola omao.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

lokele: Ilaka buse likɔlɔse, watɔ wa baeki waaka owale la Yesu Inde angɛnɛ nda boili,
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

lokele: ɛnɛkɛ Inde wɛnɛ iyo basolewa olukaka kai eoka lofofo losonana lau, Inde loyel’iyo nda mbile ya lilamba lia anɛi lia ocho. Inde lotanda olikolo lia balia la asangaka oeta iyo.
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; See Job 9:8 and he would have passed by them,

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ iyo Inde atandaka olikolo lia balia, iyo loenyela mbo ende bosoko, iyo loamama;
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

lokele: eoka iyo batotina loɛnɛ Inde la iyo lowänga finɛ. Nde Inde loonga lau lisasaya, mbo— Sambolaka betema, yende Imi angɛnɛ, owangëke!
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! 6:50 Don’t be afraid.”

lokele: Inde lokwa nda watɔ amamwito lau, la lofofo lotemba. Iyo loilima finɛ la bɔwa
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

lokele: eoka batialuwaka loasɔ loa beila la wɛlï la betema yau yaaka betembu.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

lokele: Alekaka iyo, iyo loiyela Ngenesaleta, iyo loelamesa watɔ nda ngɔngɛ.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

lokele: Asaowaka iyo lisasaya batotina lolembel’Inde
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

lokele: la iyo lokwa mangu nda yese etotina ndokatola bato ba kambo nda tange konda elela olo ayali Inde.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

lokele: Nda bilela bitotina olo akɛndɛkɛ Inde, kwa nda kombo, angoko bekenge, angoko bilanga, iyo loingesaka eba kambo nda baongo, iyo lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Inde mbo bamateke ango litamba lia esinda yande, la batotina ebamataka Inde, iyo louwesomo.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe 6:56 of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

lokele: Limɔ BaFalusi la Batikasa bamɔi ba Yelusaleme loyasɔngɔmɛlɛ Yesu;
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

lokele: iyo lɔɛnɛ baeki bande bamɔi ebasola bieka ani besamba yau bititatane, (litina mbo, bititasoolomo).
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

lokele: (BaFalusi la BaYuda angola bieka ani bakasooli besamba konda batundulundu,
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

lokele: eoka ndolitesaka imɔ ndola wike ya bangau, la atosekwak’iyo nda liongo, iyo angola imɔ bieka ani bakakwi tokuli; ele imɔ la ndola yasi wike ebitolites’iyo, biko lisooli lia kɔpɔ la tei la biɛ̈ngɔ ya mbela)
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

lokele: BaFalusi la Batikasa lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Baeki baɛ batotefola ndola ya bangau ani moni nde kola bieka la besamba ebikasoolomu?
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Yesaya atɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ wewe loasɔ loanu eba bolimbakeli-losotoma nda lokasa loande mbo— E Bato-ba batolitesa’mi la bɛnɔkɔ, Kongo ko betema yau bile esika lami.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

lokele: Batosemola’mi lisemoela, Eoka liekesi liau lile ko bikela ya bato.
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’ Isaiah 29:13

lokele: Ongoma ino otomachaka bikela ya Mungu, nde kolitesa ndola ya bato.
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

lokele: Inde mbo— Ino oluwi finɛ ndotombola bikela ya Mungu mbo oliteseke ko ndola ya bato angɛnɛ.
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

lokele: Eoka Mose loonga mbo— Litesaka sango waɛ la nyango waɛ la imɔ mbo— Oyatomɔlɔ sango kwa nyango, aweke wewe.
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ Exodus 20:12 and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’ Exodus 21:17

lokele: Nde ino otoonga mbo— Boto eonga la sango wande kwa nyango wande mbo— Yeka esambɔɔlɔ ino ende’mi, yao ele Kobana (litina mbo Lifaefi)
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” 7:11 that is to say, given to God,

lokele: limɔ osofekel’inde mbo angofa sango kwa nyango yeka.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

lokele: Ongoma osotombola lioi lia Mungu ko la baiti banu ba kwala, la otokelaka yasi wike ya bɔfɔnɔ-bɔ. Bobe boti wa lousa, kangä wa atiteni
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lota windi w’ato lioi oya ende Inde, la Inde mbo— Okaka’mi la wɛlï, ino batoti,
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ yeka eyele lousa loa oto, eyetokɔkɔlɔ ndosɛlɛ inde la bɔwɛwɛ, kangä yao ebitokuswela oto nd’atobebes’inde la bɔwɛwɛ.
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

lokele: Asɛnyanaka Inde la windi wa bato, Inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ, baeki bande lofel’Inde loasɔ loa bombila-bo.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

lokele: Inde mbo— ¿Imɔ ko ino, oti la liluwani? Otiluwe nde mbo yeka eyele lousa loa oto la eyetɔɔtɛlɛ inde, angokɔkɔlɔ ndosɛlɛ inde la bɔwɛwɛ
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

lokele: eoka yao etɔɔtɔ nda sɔlɔ yande, inga nda botema, la etonyomo nda toi. (Ongoma Yesu lɔsɔmbɔlɔ bekili ya bieka)
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?” 7:19

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga mbo— Ende yao eyetokuswa nda botema wa oto nd’atosɛlɛ inde la bɔwɛwɛ,
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

lokele: eoka bitosekwa nda botema biko-yɛmɛ ibe, bolëfë, la wiya, lioli-lia-oto, nyongo,
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

lokele: bolole, luno, bolimbake, ifoifoi, lisiëlä, limɔli, bɔfɛnɔa, la ebebe.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

lokele: Bitotina-bi bitokuswa nd’atiteni ya oto, la yao nd’atosɛlɛ oto la bɔwɛwɛ. Boseka wa yese yasi louwesomökö
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loemala, Inde lɔkɛ nda bolelo wa yese ya Tulo (la Sidona); Inde lɔɔtɔ ndakɔ la atialɛmbɛkɛ mbo bato baluweke olo ayali Inde, kongo ko atiakokɔlɔkɔ ndoisama.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

lokele: Nde lisasaya otomali oyaaka la wanaotomali wa bolimo obe, okaka inde mboli ya Yesu, inde loya oyakwa se nda bakolo bande.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

lokele: Otomali aaka wa BaHela ba tukela ya Sulo-Fonisa la inde losombola Yesu mbo akusoleke bolimo obe ende wana wande.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Bana bataokaneloko, eoka etiengane ndoɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ lituma lia bana okafaefa ngwa.
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

lokele: Botomali lomutoel’Inde mbo— Eingo Bɔkɔta, kongo ko ngwa ose ya mɛsa bitolaka bakɔmbɔ ba lituma ebatokwesa bana omao.
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Ko l’eoka ya lioi-li kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ, bolimo bosokuswa ende wanaotomali waɛ.
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

lokele: Otomali lɔkɛ eyande la inde loosha wana ani asoingala nda tange ani bolimo obe asosekwa. Boto wa bökö la likekuma
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

lokele: Asekwaka Yesu nda yese ya Tulo, inde loeta la mboka ya Sidona, la yese ya Ndekapolis konda Eliya ya Ngalilai.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

lokele: Lamao baeshelak’Inde boto wa bökö la likekuma la iyo losombol’Inde mbo atalieke bosamba wande end’inde.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

lokele: Yesu losokol’inde sisi ya bokamu wa bato, Inde lɔkɛ lande wisakumbo isisika, Inde lota tosangakala nda batoi ba oto, Inde lotwɛlɛ sɔi, Inde lomata lolamɛ loa oto;
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

lokele: limɔ Inde loticha nda use ani atotwa liena, Inde loonga lande mbo— Efata (litina mbo, Liolomoko).
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

lokele: La batoi bande loliolomo la itangau sha lolamɛ losɔmbɔlɔmɔ, inde loonga la wɛlï.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

lokele: Yesu loim’iyo mbo batakambesa oto angɔmwito, kongo ko ango aimäkäkä iyo, ongoma iyo lokakambekese bato.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

lokele: Bato lomwaala finɛfinɛ, iyo mbo— Asokelaka bitotina la olau woetela; atookesa eba bökö, la atoongesa eba biuma.
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

lokele: Nda bacho ana windi ofi wa bato waaka lande la batiaaka la yeka yola. Ataka Yesu baeki bande lioi, Inde loonga lau mbo—
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

lokele: Isookel’bato-ba ngandi eoka basotikala lami becho isatɔ la bati la yeka yola.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

lokele: Eyambo yemach’iyo mbo baɛkɛ nda bekenge yau la tosiye, iyo kowa beleka nda mboka, eoka bamɔi bende b’esika.
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

lokele: Baeki bande loonga mbo— Totokɔkɔlɔ ndoosha bieka yoengana ebato-ba ko anima, ono nda isimo-si?
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

lokele: Inde lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Ole la beila yanga? Iyo lomutola mbo— Bosambale.
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

lokele: Inde loonga la windi wa bato mbo bayaleke se nda nyɛlɛ, Inde lɔɔsɔ beila bosambale, Inde lofa kelekëlë, Inde loataka beila la Inde lofaekefa baeki bande mbo basɛlɛkɛ yao oso wa bato; iyo losɛlɛ yao oso wa windi w’ato.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

lokele: Baaka imɔ la toswiswi tɔmɔi, Inde lofa kelekele limɔ Inde loonga mbo bakaeleke imɔ ko twao.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

lokele: Iyo lola la iyo lotɛkwa; iyo loina twinyo etwatikalaka, iyo lotumesa bisaka osambale.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

lokele: Bato bayalaka kwa bilɛfu binɛi.
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lomach’iyo baɛkɛ eyau nde Inde lokwa nda watɔ amamwito la baeki bande limɔ iyo loiya nda yese ya Ndalamanuta.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

lokele: BaFalusi lokuswa eyau, iyo loakola ndofelana lande, iyo lolüka ndembe end’Inde, ndembe yosekwa nda use ndokotel’Inde.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

lokele: Inde losuma la botema wäle, Inde mbo— ¿Monito fɛtɔ-ye batolüka ndembe? Wewe, Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo Ndembe etiafomoko efɛtɔ-ye.
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation 8:12 seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

lokele: Inde lomach’iyo limɔ Inde lokwa nda watɔ liasi, Inde loleka nda boili wasi.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

lokele: Kongo ko baeki loosala ndotola lituma, batiaka la liao nda watɔ sakolo ko limɔi kongo.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

lokele: Inde loim’iyo mbo— Tɛnɛkɛ la wɛlï mbo oengweke lisoo lia lituma lia BaFalusi la elia ebaHelodi.
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

lokele: Baeki lofelana loasɔ, iyo mbo— Toti la lituma.
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

lokele: Aluwaka Yesu ongoma, Inde mbo— Monito, otofelana mbo oti la lituma? Bokɛni kɔni? Bokaluwi kɔni litina? Betema yanu yende betembu?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

lokele: Wende la baiso, nde otiɛnɛ? Wende la batoi, nde otioke? ¿Otienyele imɔ?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

lokele: Aatäkä’mi beila bɔɔmwi ndokaela bato bilɛfu bɔɔmwi, watumesäkä bisaka yanga la twinyo etwatikaläkä? Iyo mbo— Liu la imbale.
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

lokele: La ani aatäkä’mi beila osambale ndokaela bato bilɛfu inɛi, belanga yanga eyatumäkä la twinyo? Iyo mbo— Bosambale.
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ?Okaluwi kɔni? Boto wa botuku
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

lokele: La iyo loiya nda Betesaida la bato loeshel’Inde boto wa botuku la iyo lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Yesu mbo amatek’inde.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

lokele: Inde lounda ewa botuku la bosamba, Inde lɔkɛ lande nda liko lia bokenge. Achwɛlɛk’Inde sɔi nda baiso bande, la ataliaka Inde bosamba, Inde lofel’oto mbo— ¿Ɔsɔɛnɛ to yeka?
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

lokele: Oto wa botuku loila baiso likolo limɔ inde mbo— Isɔɛnɛ bato nde basoɛnɛlɛ kwa tosandu etotokɛndɛ.
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lotalia bosamba nda baiso bande liasi, la oto lotichaka la liɛni loinywa liasi, inde lɔɛnɛ bitotina sandelele.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

lokele: Yesu lotom’inde nda ndakɔ yande ani asoonga lande mbo— Okɛndɛ̈kɛ ango nda bokenge.
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu la baeki bande lɔkɛ konda bekenge bitimbi ya Kaisalia ya Filipo la aɛkɛ iyo nda mboka, Inde lofela baeki bande mbo— ¿Bato batoonga mbo Imi yende ndai?
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

lokele: Iyo lokambes’Inde mbo— Mbo wende Yoane Bolufi, nde basi mbo Eliya, la basi mbo wende ɔmɔi wa Bɛtɔndɔli.
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

lokele: Yesu lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Ino angɛnɛ nd’atoonga mbo Imi yende ndai? Petelo lomutoel’Inde mbo— Aɛ wende Masiya.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

lokele: Yesu loimak’iyo mbo batakambesa oto angomwito loasɔ loande.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loakola ndoekes’iyo mbo lole ende Wana wa oto ndooka biale wike la ndofekelomo la biange la kanga la batikasa la ndoolomo limɔ mbisa ya becho isatɔ ndokuswa nda liwa.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

lokele: Inde loonga lioi-li fololo. La Petelo lounda Yesu, inde loakola ndoimak’Inde,
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

lokele: nde Yesu lokikwa la atichak’Inde baeki, Inde loimaka Petelo mbo— Etaka ombisa yami Satana, eoka otienyele njasɔ ya Mungu kangä eya bato.
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lota windi wa bato lioi basɔngɔmɛkɛ amamwito la baeki bande, Inde loonga lau mbo— Boto ɛlɛmbɛ mbo atuteke’mi, atafekelaka inde angɛnɛ, atatolaka lieka liande la atuteke’mi.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

lokele: Eoka mbo, oyatolɛmbɛ ndoikesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, atolefesa nde liao; kongo ko oyatolefesa liwawi liande eoka yami la eoka ya mboli ilau, inde nd’atoikesa liao.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

lokele: Boto eɔlɔ bitotina ya wenda-bo, nde kolefesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, asɔɔlɔ to iye?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

lokele: ¿Boto afeke eni to yeka yofangola la liwawi liande?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

lokele: Boto oyatofekak’mi la baoi bami ko l’eoka ya sɔni nda baiso ba bato ba efɛtɔ-ye ya nyongo la obe, ongoma Wana wa oto imɔ efekaka inde la sɔni eyekayeke Inde la tala la liomala lia Sango wande amamwito la bakitomo batanu.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Isoonga lau wewe mbo bato bamɔi ebemali eya batiawëkë konda akɛnɛk’iyo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya la bofoka. Eliya la Mɔsɛ loyaongana la Yesu
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho liambɛ Yesu lɔɔsɔ Petelo la Yakobo la Yoane; Inde lɔkɛ lau olikolo lia löngo lofi ko iyo angɛnɛ kongo.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lokindolomo bɔfɔnɔ wasi oso wa baiso bau; bisinda yande longalikima finɛ, ango botanesi w’esinda angokɔkɔlɔ otanesa ongoma.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

lokele: Lamao Eliya la Mɔsɛ lɔɛnɛlɛ ani batoongana la Yesu.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

lokele: Petelo loonga la Yesu mbo— Boekesi, bolau end’iso oyala eyamaya, tosweke kumbo bisatɔ, ɛmɔi yaɛ, ɛmɔi ya Mɔsɛ, la ɛmɔi ya Eliya,
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

lokele: eoka atialüwäkä oonga la wɛlï eoka bawängäkä finɛ.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

lokele: Limɔ lifita loya oyaisa iyo, lamao limiki lookana nda lifita mbo— Oyo ende Wana wami wa losamɔ, okaka Inde.
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

lokele: Futuku, aɛlɛlɛk’iyo, batiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ imɔ oto sakolo ko Yesu amamwito lau.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

lokele: Asekwaka’iyo nda löngo, Yesu loimak’iyo mbo batakambesa oto ango ɔmɔi njasɔ ebiɛnɛk’iyo sakolo ko ani Wana wa oto asotɛmwa nda liwa.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

lokele: Iyo lolitesa lioi liande kongo ko iyo lofelana litina lia litɛmwi nda liwa.
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

lokele: Iyo lofela Inde mbo— ¿Eok’iye, batikasa batoonga mbo loengani nde mbo Eliya atayaka oso?
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Eliya nd’atoya oso ndoyakɔkɔmɛsɛ bitotina la kwa asotomo loao nda kasa ya Mungu mbo Wana wa oto ökaka bowaü la etefolomoko la sɔni.
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

lokele: Nde itoonga lanu mbo Eliya asoya ndoya la bato basokeel’inde kwa asolɛmbɛ iyo, kwa asotomo loao nda kasa. Louweso loa wana oyaaka la Olimo Obe
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

lokele: Iyaka iyo ende baeki basi, iyo lɔɛnɛ windi ofi wa bato basolingel’iyo la batikasa batofenyana lau baoi.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

lokele: Lisasaya, ɛnɛkɛ bato wɛnɛ Inde iyo lomwaala, iyo loya mangu end’Inde oyalamola Yesu.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

lokele: Inde lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Ende iye eyetofelana ino lau?
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

lokele: Oto ɔmɔi wa windi lomutola lande mbo— Boekesi, iyiki end’Aɛ la wana wami, ale la olimo wa euma,
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

lokele: la olo ekayaleke wana, bolimo eund’inde, wao kokwes’inde, atokusola fulofulo nda bɔnɔkɔ, atosiya ngɛlɛtɛ, atowangema. Yongiki la baeki baɛ mbo bakusoleke wao, nde batikɔkɔlɛ.
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye eti la liimeli; ¿Itoumwaka lanu ko mbile yanga? ¿Itokɔkɔmɛlɛ ino konda eni mbile? Eshaka inde ende’mi.
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
