lokele: Limɔ iyo loesha wana end’Inde; la ɛnɛkɛ bolimo wɛnɛ Yesu, lisasaya wao lowanja wana, inde lokwa nda nyɛlɛ, inde losiasia omao ani atokusola fulofulo nda bɔnɔkɔ.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lofela sango wande mbo— ¿Ko eni mbile esoyala inde la loo-lo? Sango mbo— Konda mbile ya wainɛngɛ;
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

lokele: la mbile wike wao waumbolak’inde la nda bösä la nda balia eoka ndosɛɛsɛlɛs’inde. Nde ango otokɔkɔlɔ okela loasɔ, okelak’iso ngandi, sungak’iso.
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Ango yekɔkɔlɔ! Oyatoimela atokɔkɔlɔ bitotina.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

lokele: Lisasaya sango w’isenge loamama mbo— Isoimela nde, sungaka boeno wami wa liimeli.
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Yesu mbo windi w’ato batosɔngɔmɛlɛ iyo, Inde loimaka bolimo obe, Inde mbo— Aɛ bolimo w’euma la wa bökö, Imi nd’atoonga laɛ mbo— Kuswaka end’inde la ɔɔtɛlɛ̈k’inde imɔ liasi.
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

lokele: Wao loamama, wao lokwes’inde se, wao lokuswa. Isenge loyala kwa mbo asowa, eokao wike loonga mbo asowa.
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu loundel’inde bosamba, Inde loemes’inde, inde loemala fii.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

lokele: Aɔtɔkɔ Yesu nda ndakɔ, baeki bande lofel’Inde ko wisakumbo mbo— ¿Iso angokɔkɔlɔ okusola wao monito?
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— E-kanda-ye angokɔkɔlɔ okuswa sakolo ko la lisomboli.
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

lokele: Asokwaka iyo omao, iyo loeta ko la yese ya Ngalilai, nde atialɛmbɛkɛ mbo bato baluweke ongoma
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

lokele: eoka atokambesa baeki bande mbo— Wana wa oto atowambomo nda besamba ya bato la batool’Inde, nde atoolomo Inde, limɔ mbisa ya becho isatɔ, atotɛmwa liasi.
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

lokele: Kongo ko batialüwäkä la wɛlï lioi-li la iyo lowanga ndofel’Inde litina.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

lokele: Iyo loiyela Kafenauma, la ayalaka Inde nda ndakɔ, Yesu lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Nda mboka, ino ofenyaniki nde baoi nda loni loasɔ?
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

lokele: Nde iyo loyala hai, eoka nda mboka iyo lofenyana baoi mbo ndai asolongela.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

lokele: Yesu loyala se; Inde lota baeki liu la ambale lioi, Inde loonga lau mbo— Boto ɛlɛmbɛ oyala botoli oso, ayaleke mbisa y’atoti la akuweleke batoti.
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lounda wana ɔkɛkɛ, Inde loemesa wana sisi yau; Inde lokusamel’inde nda besamba,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

lokele: limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— Oyatonyangela wana ɔmɔi kwa wana-yo ko l’eoka ya lina liami, atonyangela’mi la oyatonyangela’mi, atinyangele ko ’mi kongo, nde atonyangela nde Inde oyatomaka’mi.
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

lokele: Yoane loonga mbo— Boekesi, twɛniki oto ɔmɔi oyatokusola belimo ebe nda lina liaɛ, la twaimak’inde, eoka aitotut’iso.
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Oimëk’inde, eoka boto oyatokela ikesa nda lina liami, oyo angokɔkɔlɔ ndotɔ̈ngɔ’mi la mangu.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

lokele: Eoka boto oyaitoiyel’iso, oyo ale wasu.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

lokele: Boto efaef’ino kɔpɔ ya balia bomwa eoka mbo wende ba Masiya, Imi mbo— wewe, boto-ao angoomelo bosombo wande.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

lokele: Oyatokwesa wainɛngɛ ɔmɔi oyatoimela’mi, losoeta lande olau mbo litalɛ lifi likandomoko nda kingo yande la aumbolomoko nda balia ba eliya.
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

lokele: Bosamba waɛ bokwes’aɛ nda obe, tenaka wao; ndɔɔtɔ nda loiko ko eleme la bosamba ɔmɔi kongo, losoeta okɛsɔmɔ nda Ngehena la besamba imbale nda bösä ebotikɔkɔlɛ otiamesomo.
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, 9:43 into the unquenchable fire,

lokele: Bokolo waɛ bokwes’aɛ nda obe, tenaka wao, ndɔɔtɔ nda loiko la ekoti kongo, losoeta okɛsɔmɔ nda Ngehena la bakolo ambale.
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, 9:45 into the fire that will never be quenched—

lokele: Eyambo liso liaɛ likwes’aɛ nda obe, ɔ̈mɔlɔkɔ liao, ndɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu ko ɛtwɛlɛ kongo, losoeta okɛsɔmɔ nda Ngehena la baiso bambale
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna 9:47 of fire,

lokele: olo lokuso loau loitowa la bösä boitotiamesomo.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’ Isaiah 66:24

lokele: Bato batoti batotomo bösä kwa bokwa wa litanesi.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

lokele: Bokwa wende olau; kongo ko eyambo bokwa botemba shokana, limɔ otota wao shokana liasi ko l’iye? Yalaka to la bokwa atiteni yanu limɔ yalanaka la lilatemi.
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

lokele: Asekwaka Yesu omao, Inde lɔkɛ nda yese ya Yudea la konda fangi yasi ya Yaladene, la bato wike losɔngɔmɛlɛ Inde liasi, la Inde loekes’iyo kwa akelakäkä Inde oso.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

lokele: BaFalusi bamɔi loya end’Inde oyafel’Inde felo yokɔtɔl’Inde, Iyo mbo— ¿Loengani nde la Bikela mbo botolome asokoleke wali’ande?
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Mose nd’atelak’ino eni ekela?
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Mose amachelak’oto ndosɔnɔ lokasa losɛnyana la losokola wali.
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ko l’eoka ya betema yanu bewaü, Mose nda’amachelakä ino ekela ena,
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

lokele: kongo ko nda baakoelo Mungu akelaka iyo, la otolome la otomali.
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female. Genesis 1:27

lokele: Eokao botolome atomacha nde sango la nyango’ande la atowatema la wali’ande, la iyo yaambale batoyala oto ɔmwito;
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

lokele: bat’imɔ bindo imbale, kangä ɛmwito;
english: and the two will become one flesh, Genesis 2:24 so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

lokele: eokao eyesowacha Mungu, bato angowatola yao.
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

lokele: Nda ndakɔ baeki bande lofel’Inde liasi nda loasɔ-lo.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Boto oyatosokola wali’ande la kosɔngɔ wasi, inde nd’atotwela wali’ande nyongo;
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

lokele: la otomali ɛsɔngɔnɔ la otolome wasi ani asosokola olome, asotwa nyongo. Yesu la Bainɛngɛ
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

lokele: Aeshelak’iyo bana baoli ende Yesu mbo amatek’iyo, baeki loima ebayaka la bana.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ Yesu ongoma Inde looka botema wale finɛ; Inde mbo— Machaka bana baoli bayeke ende’mi. Okufesëk’iyo, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu wende ende ebofɔnɔ-bo.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

lokele: Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyaitoaela Bokɔta wa Mungu kwa atokela wainɛngɛ, ani inde angɔɔtɔ omao.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lokusamel’iyo, l’ani asotalia bangasi end’iyo, Inde lofotesa bana la baoi balau. Boto wa Lifoka
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

lokele: Atangwak’Inde okaila lɔkɛndɔ, boto ɔmɔi loyel’Inde la mangu; inde lokwa bakulusembe oso wa Yesu, inde lofela Yesu mbo— Boekesi Bolau, ikeleke moni mbo yɔ̈leke loiko loa layalaya?
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lande mbo— Monito ototanga’mi bolau? Angwɛnɛ ango ɔmɔi olau sakolo ko Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

lokele: Oluwi nde Bikela, Ochwëke nyongo, Wolëke oto, Wiyëke, Otëke nanga, Olimbëke oto, Litesaka sango waɛ la nyango.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’” Exodus 20:12-16

lokele: Inde loonga mbo— Boekesi, isolitesa e-bikela-bi bitotina konda isenge shami konda eweuse.
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

lokele: Atinganaka Yesu lande, Inde losama inde, la Inde loonga lande mbo— Osoomelo lɔmɔi kongo; kɛndɛkɛ okatambesa bitotina ebile laɛ, faefaka yao ende bato touwe, -ongoma otɔɔlɔ bondanda nda Use-limɔ yauku tutaka’mi.
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

lokele: Bɔmbɔ wande lokwelo wuno eoka ya lioi-li, inde lɔkɛ la ikɛnɛnɛ nda otema eoka aaka lifoka lia likama.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

lokele: Yesu lɔɛlɛlɛ baeki bande, Inde loonga lau mbo— Aina owaü ende bafoka ndɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

lokele: Baeki lomwaala baoi bande, nde Yesu loonga lau liasi mbo— Bana’mi, aina owaü ndɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

lokele: Bowaü wa ngamela woeta nda lifola lia iolo, botiengane la bowaü wa oto wa lifoka ndɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: La iyo lomwaala finɛ, iyo mbo— Ndai to atokɔkɔlɔ ouwesomo?
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

lokele: Yesu lotingana lau, Inde mbo— Lona losolongela bato, nde inga to Mungu, eoka Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ bitotina.
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

lokele: Petelo leakola oonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛ, iso nd’asomacha bitotina yasu la tosotutak’Aɛ.
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo, Boto oyamachi ndakɔ, angoko baloo, angoko baelo, angoko nyango, angoko sango, angoko bana, angoko bilanga, ko l’eoka yami la eoka ya mboli ilau,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

lokele: ɛɔlɔkɔ nde nda mbile-ye mia ya ndakɔ, ya baloo, ya baelo, ya banyango, ya bana, ya bilanga, amamwito la likongolomu, la nda mbile eyekayeke loiko loa layalaya.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

lokele: Nde wike ebale betoli oso, bende ko mbisa; la eba mbisa betolaka oso.
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

lokele: Akɛndɛkɛ iyo nda mboka ya Yelusaleme, Yesu loetel’iyo oso la iyo losisimwa la ebatutak’Inde lowängaka. Aoshäkä eba liu la ambale oosh’Inde liasi, Inde loakola okambes’iyo njasɔ ebikayeke ende Inde,
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

lokele: Inde mbo— Tɛnɛ, tosɔkɛ Yelusaleme, lamao Wana wa oto atowambomo ende kanga ebieti la batikasa, iyo ana batof’Inde se mbo aolomoko, limɔ batɔkɛsɛ Inde ende bato ba yese yasi,
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

lokele: batot’Inde kungutu, batochwɛlɛ Inde sɔi la batoomak’Inde fimbo, la batool’Inde la mbisa ya becho isatɔ atouwa liasi. Liömbi lia Yakobo la Yoane
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

lokele: Banatolome bambale ba Sebedai, bako Yakobo la Yoane, loya ende Yesu, iyo mbo— Boekesi, tolɛmbi mbo okeelek’iso kwa atofel’iso ofel’Aɛ.
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

lokele: Inde mbo— Olɛmbi mbo ikeelek’ino to iye?
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Lɛmbɛlɛkɛ mbo toyaleke laɛ, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa olome, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa wali, eyalayalek’Aɛ nda tala yaɛ.
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

lokele: Nde Yesu mbo— Otiluwe elosofel’ino ofela’mi. ¿Otokɔkɔlɔ nde ndomwa kɔpɔ eyetomwa’mi la otokɔkɔlɔ ndolufiomo la lilufi eyetolufiomo lami?
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Totokɔkɔlɔ. Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Otomwa nde kɔpɔ eyetomwa’mi la otolufiomo la lilufi elitolufiomo lami,
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

lokele: nde ndoyales’ino nda osamba w’olome la nda ewa wali, loti loami ndof’ino kangä ende ebasotonjelomo loao.
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

lokele: Okaka eba liu baoi-ba, iyo losoma la Yakobo la Yoane.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lot’iyo lioi, Inde loonga lau mbo— Oluwi mbo bato ebasotangomo betoli oso ya yese yasi, batoka-kales’iyo la bato bafi bau bende la isosha end’iyo.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

lokele: End’ino, loti ongoma, kongo ko oyatolɛmbɛ mbo ayaleke boto bofi wanu, ayaleke bokuweli wanu,
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

lokele: la oyatolɛmbɛ mbo ayaleke botoli oso wanu, inde koyala bɔkɔwa wa batotina.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

lokele: Wana wa oto, imɔ, atiye ndokuwelomo, kangä okuwela basi, la ndofa liwawi liande angɛnɛ kwa liendoli lia bato wike. Batimayo
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lɔkɛ Yeliko… asekwak’Inde Yeliko amamwito la baeki bande la windi wa bato, BaTimayo, wana wa Timayo, ayalaka la botuku, inde loyalaka se nda ɔngɔ wa mboka ani atömba yeka.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

lokele: Okaka inde mbo ende Yesu wa Nasaleta inde loakola ndoamama, mbo— Yesu, Wana wa Dawidi, okelak’mi ngandi.
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

lokele: Bato wike loim’inde mbo ayaleke tau, kongo ko inde loamama liamami lioeta, mbo— Yesu, Wana wa Dawidi, okelaka’mi ngandi.
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

lokele: Yesu losikama, Inde mbo— Tak’inde lioi. Iyo lota ewa botuku lioi, iyo mbo— Tendelaka, emalaka, asot’aɛ lioi.
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

lokele: Umbolak’inde esinda yande, inde loemala, inde loya ende Yesu.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

lokele: Yesu lofel’inde mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo ikeelek’aɛ iye? Boto wa botuku loonga lande mbo— Boekesi mbo yɛnɛkɛ liasi.
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, 10:51 that I may see again.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ, liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ. Lisasaya inde lɔɔlɔ liɛni liasi, inde lotuta Yesu nda mboka.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

lokele: Iyaka iyo tina la Yelusaleme nda Betefange la Betania, ebile nda mboka ya löngo loa Elaya, Yesu lotoma baeki bande bambale oso wande,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage 11:1 and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda okenge ebole oso wanu nda mboka la atoiya ino nda liko lia wao, lisasaya otoosha efembeli ya punda ekandomu; boto akayali kɔni nda bɔkɔngɔ wa yao.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

lokele: Faikolaka yao, eshaka yao lono. Boto eonga lanu mbo— ¿Monito osokela ani? ino koonga mbo Ngɛnɛ asoeno yao, la atoinola yao ono lisasaya.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛ, iyo loosha efembeli ya punda ekandomu nda bome wa ndakɔ lousa nda mboka, la iyo lofaikola yao.
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

lokele: Bamɔi ebemalaka omao loonga lau mbo— ¿Iye eyetokel’ino ofaikola punda?
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

lokele: Baeki loonga lau kwa aongi Yesu lau la bato lomachel’iyo.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

lokele: Iyo loesha efembeli ya punda ende Yesu, baeki lotalia bisinda yau nda bɔkɔngɔ wa yao; la Yesu loyala se nda yao.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

lokele: Bato wike lofalola bisinda yau se nda mboka, la basi lota bafifa ba tosandu se nda mboka ebatenik’iyo nda bilanga.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

lokele: La ebaetelaka oso l’ebatutaka mbisa, iyo lowɛlɛ lielo mbo— Hosana, Limɛngɔ la olau end’Inde oyasoya nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ,
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! 11:9 Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Psalms 118:25-26

lokele: Limɛngɔ la olau nda yakakaelo ya Dawidi, sango wasu, Hosana nda elela ya tala.
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

lokele: Ongoma Yesu lɔɔtɔ Yelusaleme, nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la aɛlɛlɛkɛ bitotina, limɔ eoka buse bosoila litele, Inde losekwa okakɛ nda Betania amamwito la baeki liu la bambale.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ asokwaka iyo nda Betania, Yesu looka isiye,
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

lokele: la esika Inde lɔɛnɛ bokumo ebole la kasa, Inde loya oyɛnɛ kwa mbo atoosha tuma nda wao. Nde iyaka Inde nda wao, Inde loosha ko kasa ko kasa, eoka eula ya tuma etitayaka kɔni.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

lokele: Yesu loonga la bokumo mbo— Boto angola imɔ tuma twaɛ liasi. Baeki bande looka lioi-li. Lotaneso loa balele ba Tempelo
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

lokele: Iyaka iyo nda Yelusaleme, Yesu lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la Inde loakola ndokusola bato ebatoungesa la ebatosomba; Inde loukokola baonga ba bafetekwani ba bieto la kangala ya ebaungesaka bikuku.
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

lokele: Inde atiamachaka boto angomwito oeta Ndakɔ ani atoli ɛɛngɔ.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

lokele: Inde loekes’iyo, inde mbo— ¿Lotisɔnɔmɔ nda lokasa mbo Ndakɔ yami etotangomo Ndakɔ ya lisomboli ya bato ba yese bitoti? Kongo ko ino nd’asokela la yao, ko lisɛkɔ lia eba biya.
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? Isaiah 56:7 But you have made it a den of robbers!” Jeremiah 7:11

lokele: Okaka iyo loasɔ-lo, kanga bieti la batikasa loluka loasɔ mbo bolek’Inde, eoka bawangaka Inde ani batotina lomwaala liekesi liande.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

lokele: Lise la lise, ani atoila buse litele, iyo losekwaka nda okenge.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

lokele: Limɔ lanɔngɔ, etaka iyo nda mboka iyo lɔɛnɛ bokumo ani bosobɛɛlɛ ko la biili.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

lokele: Petelo loenyela loasɔ loa wao, inde loonga lande mbo— Boekesi, tɛnɛ bokumo ebotutunyiki Aɛ, wao bosobɛɛlɛ.
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola, Inde loonga lau mbo— Lendeloko Mungu.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

lokele: Wewe, isoonga lanu mbo boto eonga la löngo-lo mbo— Ilomoko la umbolomoko tubu nda balia, ani atite fee nda otema wande, nde asoimela mbo elosoong’inde lotoya wewe, lotoya nde end’inde.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

lokele: Eokao itoonga lanu mbo, loao elotolɔmbɔkɔl’ino la elotofelak’ino, imelaka mbo osɔɔlɔ loao la loao koyel’ino.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

lokele: Atoemala ino ndosombola, boyala la oto loasɔ, tamɛsɛlɛk’inde, mbo Sango wanu imɔ oyale nda Use, amɛsɛlɛkɛ ino njasɔ ibe yanu.
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

lokele: Iyaka iyo liasi nda Yelusaleme, Yesu lɔkɛndɛkɛndɛ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la kanga ebieti la batikasa la biange loya ende Inde;
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

lokele: iyo loonga lande mbo— ¿Otokelaka njasɔ-bi la sini isosha? ¿Ndai afak’Aɛ isosha-si shokela yao?
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Itofel’ino lofelo lɔmɔi, tamutoelaka’mi la itokambes’ino isosha esitokelaka lami njasɔ-bi;
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

lokele: ¿Lilufi lia Yoane liaka nde elia Use kwa elia bato? Mutoelaka’mi.
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

lokele: Iyo angɛnɛ lotafelakana, mbo— Eyambo toonga mbo liaka elia Use, limɔ Inde koonga lasu mbo ¿Eokao, monito otiaimelak’inde?
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

lokele: nde toonga mbo, elia bato… bawangäkä windi wa bato eoka batotina bimelaka mbo Yoane aaka bɔtɔndɔli wewe.
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

lokele: la iyo lomutoela Yesu mbo— Totilüwe.
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loakola ndoonga lau ko la bembila. Inde mbo— Oto ɔmɔi alɔɔkɔ elanga ya tuma inde lolingela yao la likula, inde loswa liöndo liotwanga tuma, inde loemesa ndakɔ ya betingani, inde lomacha elanga ende balɔi, inde lɔkɛ yese yasi.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

lokele: Ayaka eula ya tuma, inde lotoma bɔkɔwa ende balɔi mbo aɔsɛkɛ tuma tɔmɔi twa elanga yande.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

lokele: Iyo loundesa bɔkɔwa, iyo lokuchak’inde, iyo losaya inde besamba wawa.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

lokele: Limɔ liasi inde lotomel’iyo bɔkɔwa wasi, iyo losw’inde nda otö, iyo lokeel’inde sɔni.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

lokele: Inde lotoma wasi, iyo lool’inde. Inde lotomaka basi wike, iyo lokuchaka bamɔi, iyo loola bamɔi.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

lokele: Atikalaka ko wana ɔmwito ewa losamɔ, inde lotomel’inde end’iyo liili, inde mbo— Batolitesa wana wami.
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

lokele: Nde balɔi ana loongana mbo— Oyo ende bosangesi wa botiko, yauku to, tooleke inde limɔ iso totɔɔlɔ botiko.
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

lokele: Ongoma iyo lound’inde, iyo lool’inde la iyo loumbola bolyo wande lousa loa elanga.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

lokele: ¿Ngɛnɛ wa elanga ekelaka to iye? Eyaka nde la atosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ balɔi ana, la atofaefa basi elanga yande.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

lokele: Okatangi lioi-li nda lokasa mbo— Litalɛ lina elisofeka baswi, Liao lisoyaswomo nda botö wa ndakɔ,
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo losoya ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, La nda baiso basu lole losemolomo.
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?” Psalms 118:22-23

lokele: Iyo loluka fofe youndes’Inde kongo ko iyo lowanga windi wa bato, eoka iyo lolüwa mbo Yesu asotombol’iyo nda bombila-bo. Iyo lomach’Inde, iyo lɔkɛ eyau. Bosombi wa Kaisala
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lotomel’Inde bamɔi ba BaFalusi la bamɔi ebatutaka Helodi mbo bakweseke Inde nda baoi,
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

lokele: ayaka iyo end’Inde iyo mbo— Boekesi, tosolüwa mbo wende wewe la mbo oitowanga oto la oitolitesa isosha sha bato, nde otoekesa wewe wa mboka ya Mungu. Losoengana ofaefa Kaisala bosombi kwa angofa? ¿Tofaefeke kwa iso angofa?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu lolembeela shɔngɔlɔ shau, Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Otokotela’mi eoka iye? Eshelaka’mi lofalanga mbo yɛnɛkɛ loao.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

lokele: Iyo loeshel’Inde lɔmɔi, limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Bolendela-bo bole wa ndai? la lisɔni-li lile lia ndai? Iyo loonga lande mbo— Elia Kaisala.
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Inolaka to ende Kaisala ko eya Kaisala la inolaka ende Mungu ko eya Mungu. Iyo lomwaala finɛ. Litɛmwi nda Liwa
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

lokele: Lamao BaSadoke bamɔi loya ende Inde, baimelaka mbo angwɛnɛ imɔ litɛmwi nda liwa; iyo lofel’Inde mbo—
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

lokele: Boekesi, Mose atelak’iso lokasa mbo boloo ewa, ani amachi wali nde atiyale la wana, limɔ etungani atosangola lotika loa boloo mbo aoteleke boloo wana.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

lokele: Baaka batolome osambale, bana ba sango ɔmwito; ewa oso losɔngɔ wali la inde lowa, nde atimache wana,
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

lokele: ewa ambale losangola wali, la inde imɔ lowa angomacha wana, la ewa asatɔ ko ongoma,
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

lokele: la iyo osambale ko ongoma, angomacha wana; la otomali imɔ lowa liili.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

lokele: Nda litɛmwi nda liwa, atotɛmwa iyo, otomali atoyala wali wa ndai, eoka iyo batotina bosambale basɔngɔkɔ inde?
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— ¿Oisounga eoka mbo oitolüwa Kasa ya Mungu la bofoka wande imɔ?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

lokele: Atotɛmwa ato nda liwa, batolome angosɔngɔ, la batomali angosɔngɔmɔ imɔ, nde beyalaka kwa bakitomo nda use.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

lokele: La loasɔ loa ebawaka la litɛmwi liau, okatangi kɔni nda Lokasa loa Mose nda loasɔ loa isasandu esitiafyaka, mbo Mungu loonga la Mose mbo— Imi, yende Mungu wa Abalayama, Mungu wa Isaka, la Mungu wa Yakobo; okatangi ongoma?
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? Exodus 3:6

lokele: Mungu ati Mungu wa ebawi, kangä wa ebale la liwawi. Eokao ino osoungaka finɛ. Bikela ebieti
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

lokele: Limɔ botikasa ɔmɔi loya ende Yesu la okaka inde kwa asofenyana iyo la mbo Yesu asomutoel’iyo sandelele, inde lofela Yesu mbo— ¿Eni ekela etolongela bitotina?
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Eyesolongela ende mbo, Tokaka, ino BaYisalaele, Bɔkɔta Mungu wasu ende Bɔkɔta ko ɔmwito;
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

lokele: Samaka Bɔkɔta Mungu waɛ la botema bototina, la bolimo waɛ bototina, la baenyeli baɛ batotina, la bofoka waɛ bototina.
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ Deuteronomy 6:4-5 This is the first commandment.

lokele: Eya imbale ende mbo— Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa ani otosama aɛ angɛnɛ. Angwɛnɛ imɔ ekela nde kolongela ebi.
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ Leviticus 19:18 There is no other commandment greater than these.”

lokele: Limɔ Botikasa ona loonga lande mbo— Eingo ko Boekesi, osoonga wewe mbo Mungu ende ko ɔmwito la wasi atiyale, ko Inde angɛnɛ,
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

lokele: la ndosama Inde la botema bototina la baenyeli batotina la bofoka bototina, la ndosama boyalani laɛ kwa aɛ angɛnɛ, ndokelaka ongoma losolongela lifaefi lia nyama yofechomo.
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

lokele: Okaka Yesu ani amutolaka inde la wɛlï, Inde loonga lande mbo— Aɛ oti esika la Bɔkɔta wa Mungu. Limɔ angwɛnɛ oto lotendela ofela Inde lofelo loasi.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

lokele: Aaka Yesu atoekesa nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, Inde mbo— ¿Monito batikasa batoonga mbo Masiya ende wana wa Dawidi?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

lokele: Dawidi angɛnɛ, ko la Bolimo Botanu loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ loonga la Ngɛnɛ wami mbo Yalaka se nda osamba wami wa olome, Kond’atosɛlɛ’mi baiyani baɛ ose ya batindi baɛ.
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’ Psalms 110:1

lokele: Dawidi angɛnɛ atangak’Inde mbo Ngɛnɛ, ¿Ale to wana wande la moni? Ongoma windi wa bato lookaka Yesu la limɛngɔ.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

lokele: Aekesaka Inde bato, Yesu mbo— Lambaka batikasa ebalɛmbi okɛndɛkɛndɛ la bisinda bisa la mbo balamolomoko nda baongo,
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

lokele: la mbo bafomoko kangala ya betolioso nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la bilela ya oso nda bilambɔ.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

lokele: Batɔɔsɔkɔ ndakɔ ya ebawelu olome, limɔ batosombolaka basomboli ba yumwa ko la bolimbake wau; kongo ko belafomoko se la likuchi lioeta. Lifaefi lia Oyawelu Olome
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loyala se tina la ɛsɔnjɛlɔ ya bieto la Inde lɔɛnɛ bato ani batotaka bieto nda sanduku ya lifaefi, la bato wike ba bafoka lotaka bieto wike,
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

lokele: otomali oyawelu olome ko iuwe, inde loya oyata ko bakute bambale kongo.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, 12:42 which equal a quadrans coin. 12:42

lokele: Yesu lota baeki bande lioi, Inde mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe mbo Otomali-yo oyawelu olome ale iuwe nde asota lifaefi liolongela batotina ebasokusola bieto nda sanduku,
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

lokele: eoka iyo ana batotina basokusola sinyo sha lilya liau, kongo ko inde oyale la boenu asokusola eyande bitotina, ango yao ebilendeluku inde.
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

lokele: Akuswaka Yesu nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu boeki ɔmɔi wande loonga lande mbo— Boekesi, tɛnɛ; boni bɔfɔnɔ wa batalɛ-ba la aina bosweli-bo!
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

lokele: La Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Wɛni nde bosweli-bo bofi? Angwɛnɛ litalɛ ango limɔi lilamachomoko likolo lia liasi nde batoti belaukolomoko.
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

lokele: Ayalaka Inde se nda löngo loa Elaya, fangi ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu, eba Petelo la Yakobo la Yoane la Andelo lofel’Inde wisakumbo mbo—
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

lokele: Kambesaka iso mbile eyekayeke njasɔ-bi la ndembe yolembela mbo bisamboya.
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loakola ndoonga lau mbo— Lambaka la wɛlï mbo botalimbomo,
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

lokele: eoka wike batoya nda lina liami ani batoonga mbo— Imi yende Inde la batoengola basi wike.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ 13:6 and will lead many astray.

lokele: Atook’ino mboli ya bita la iwaesa sha bita, owangëke, eoka bilayaka nde, kongo ko losilo lokayi kɔni.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

lokele: Yese la yese bitowesana, la bɔkɔta la bɔkɔta batowesana, lotukeso loa nyɛlɛ la elela la elela, la fondo bilayaka, yao ina bile ko liakoli lia ielo.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

lokele: Ino angɛnɛ lambaka to eoka bekɛsɛk’ino ende eb’ikumbɛ la nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ, beomakak’ino la fimbo, bemesak’ino oso wa bekumi la bɛkɔta ko l’eoka yami, mbo okulieke’mi oso wau.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

lokele: la oso wa yao, Mboli Ilau konangolomo nda biese bitotina.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

lokele: Atoiliakomo ino ndokakɛsɔmɔ ende bekumi, otakelëke olenda eoka ya baoi boonga nde baoi ebakafomoko ino nda mbile-ao, ongaka ko bao, eoka bati ino angɛnɛ nd’atoonga kangä Bolimo Botanu.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Boloo atowamba etungani nda liwa, la sango atowamba wana, la bana batowesana la ebaot’iyo mbo bakɛsɛk’iyo nda liwa;
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

lokele: la batotina batoiyana lanu eoka ya lina liami. Nde inde oyatokɔkɔmɔ konda losilo, inde elauwesomoko.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

lokele: Akɛnɛkɛ ino wɛnɛ bɔlɛlɔ wa lioma bosoyala olo eyeti elela ya liao, (oyatotanga aluweke litina), limɔ eba Yudea bakweke mangu konda föngo,
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, Daniel 9:27 spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

lokele: boto eyala olikolo lia ndakɔ imɔ, angotasulwa se okaluke biengo nda ndakɔ;
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

lokele: boto eyala nda elanga, angoinywa imɔ okenge okɔsɔ esinda.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

lokele: Aeko, wale ende batomali ba lieme nda bacho ana la ebatomwesa bana baɛlɛ imɔ.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

lokele: Sombolaka mbo lotaya nda tengai ya bɔfɛfyɔ,
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

lokele: eoka nda bacho ana bifembi belayaka kwa ebitiayäkä oso, angoko nda baakoelo ebakelaka Mungu wenda konda kwani la botilayeke imɔ liasi ongoma. Aenaka Ngɛnɛ atungesaka bacho ana, ani angwɛnɛ ango ɔmwito oyatouwa, kongo ko asotungesa bacho ana ko l’eoka ya ebaaomoko lande.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

lokele: Nda mbile ena, eyambo boto eonga lanu mbo— Tɛnɛ Masiya eyamaya. Tɛnɛ ale onamona, wimelëke,
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

lokele: eoka baMasiya ba nanga la bɛtɔndɔli ya nanga beyaka nde la tokesa la ndembe ya isosha mbo bekɔkɔlɔkɔ ndolimba ango ebasoaaomo angɛnɛ.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

lokele: Lambaka to la wɛlï, Imi nd’asokambes’ino bitotina oso.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

lokele: Kongo ko nda bacho ana, mbisa ya bifembi ina, liso lia use litotufatufa la tengai angoanyema,
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

lokele: la tolonge totokwaka se la befoka ya use betotukatuka.
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken. Isaiah 13:10

lokele: Lamao belɛnɛkɛ Wana wa oto atoya nda bafita la bofoka bofi la bɔfɛkɔ.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

lokele: Limɔ atotoma bakitomo bande okasɔnjak’iyo ebasoaaomo l’olo l’olo fangi bitotina, konda liko lia ose ko nda liko lia use.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

lokele: Ekaka litina lia bombila wa bokumo; atofɛtɛ wao la atɔ̈tɛkɛ batɔmbɔ ba wao, otolüwa mbo eula esamboya.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

lokele: Ko ongoma akɛnɛkɛ ino wɛnɛ njasɔ-bi lüwaka mbo Inde asoya tina ango nda bome.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe mbo e-fɛtɔ-ye eitosila oso ani e-njasɔ-bi bitotina bikayi.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation 13:30 will not pass away until all these things happen.

lokele: Buse la se bilawanjwaka bao, kongo ko baoi bami batilawanjweke imɔ.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ oto angɔmwito alüwi lise lina kwa saa ina, bakitomo angolüwa, Wana angolüwa, sakolo ko Sango Inde angɛnɛ nd’alüwi.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

lokele: Lambaka la wɛlï, tinganaka imɔ, oitolüwa yose ena.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

lokele: Ende kwa oto oyakɛndɛkɛ esika, inde lomacha ndakɔ yande la inde lofa bakuwi bande isosha la likuwa liande, oto la oto, la inde lokambesa botingani wa bome mbo alambeke la wɛlï.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

lokele: Lambaka to, eoka otiluwe mbile eyekayeke Ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ, angoko la litele, angoko la ɛsɔkɔ, angoko la yombe, angoko la bonyanya booku,
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

lokele: ataya futuku la mbo ataosh’ino nda tɔlɔ.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

lokele: La kwa atoonga’mi end’ino, itoonga ko ende batotina, mbo— Lambaka.
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

lokele: Atikalaka becho imbale oso wa Elambɔ eya Lieti angɛnɛ la eya lituma, kanga ebieti la batikasa loluka fofe youndes’Inde ko la shɔngɔlɔ mbo bolek’Inde,
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

lokele: nde iyo loonga mbo— Inga nda lise lia Elambɔ mbo bato batakelaka etondo efi.
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

lokele: Ayalaka Yesu nda Betania nda ndakɔ ya oto ɔmɔi ako Simona ewa baɛndi, la ayalak’Inde nda mɛsa, otomali loya la isako sha litalɛ, sha baningo ba liɛsɛ ba loketi lofi fafo; otomali loata isako la inde losondola bao nda otö wa Yesu.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

lokele: Bamɔi ebayalaka omao iyo loongana la botema wale, iyo mbo— ¿Baningo-ba basoseyama eok’iye?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

lokele: Bao beungesomo ani loketi lotolongela falanga mia isatɔ la yao kofomo ende eba touwe. La bato loimaima eoka ya otomali.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii 14:5 and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu loonga mbo— Machaka otomali; ¿Otosomel’inde moni? Asokeela’mi likeeli lilau fafo.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

lokele: Wende la eba touwe lanu mbile bitoti la atolɛmbɛ ino okeel’iyo booto, ino kokɔkɔlɔ, nde oti lami amamwito lanu mbile bitotina.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

lokele: Asokeel’mi kwa asokɔkɔlɔ inde; asotasondola baningo nda bindo yami oso wa loombomo loami.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe to, mbo l’olo l’olo atonangolomo Mboli Ilau nda wenda bototi, eloasɔ-lo elosokeel’inde, loao imɔ koongomo kwa loenyelesomo loa otomali-yo. Yudasi
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

lokele: Lamao Yudasi wa Keliote, ɔmɔi wa eba liu la ambale, lɔkɛ ende kanga ebieti mbo awambeke Yesu end’iyo.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

lokele: Okak’iyo ongoma iyo loomala finɛ, iyo lotikel’inde lisakä liofaef’inde bieto; limɔ Yudasi loluka fofe yowamba Yesu. Elambɔ ya BaYuda
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

lokele: Nda lise lia oso lia Elambɔ ya lituma, ani atool’iyo bɔkɔkɔ wa Lieti, baeki bande loonga lande mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo toɛkɛ okakomya Elambɔ ya Lieti mbo oleke yao anima to?
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lotoma baeki bande bambale, Inde loonga lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda okenge la amao ototowana la otolome oyatoli tei ya balia, tutak’inde,
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

lokele: la olo akaɔtɛkɛ oto, ino koonga la ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ-ao mbo— Boekesi mbo— ¿Kuku yami ya ndakɔ eyetola’mi Elambɔ ya Lieti amamwito la baeki bami, anima to?
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

lokele: Limɔ boto-ao atotamb’ino kuku efi ya likolo eyesotonjomo la baonga, komyelak’iso omao.
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

lokele: Baeki lɔkɛ, iyo loiya nda okenge, iyo lɔɛnɛ kwa aongiki Yesu lau, iyo lokomya Elambɔ.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

lokele: Ilaka buse likɔlɔse Inde loya amamwito la baeki liu la ambale;
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

lokele: ayalak’iyo se ndola bieka, Yesu loonga lau mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe mbo ɔmɔi wanu nd’atowamba’mi, ɔmɔi oyatola bieka lami.
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

lokele: Iyo looka ikɛnɛnɛ la iyo loakola ndoonga lande, ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi mbo— ¿Ende to imi?
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau, mbo— Ende ɔmɔi wanu liu la ambale, oyatotaela lami nda lofɛfɛ, inde’yo.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

lokele: Wana wa oto atɔkɛ ndɔkɛ kwa atomoko nda Lokasa eoka yande, kongo ko aeko wale ende oto ona oyatowamba Wana wa oto. Bolau ende oto-ao ani atiaotomökö angootomo. Elambɔ ya Masiya
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

lokele: Alak’iyo, Yesu lɔɔsɔ lituma, Inde lofa kelekele, Inde louna liao, Inde lofaef’iyo liao, Inde mbo— Ɔsɔkɔ, liao lile bindo yami.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lɔɔsɔ kɔpɔ, Inde lofa kelekele, Inde lofaef’iyo, iyo batoti lomwa yao.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Eba bende bakila bami ba Ngɛla Eyai ebasosendolomo eoka ya bato wike.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe, mbo— Itiamwe imɔ liamɔ lia tuma konda lise lina elikamweke’mi liao liyai nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lochwa bɔɛlɛ, iyo lokuswa okakɛ nda löngo loa Elaya.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

lokele: Yesu mbo— Ino yaatoti otokwa se eoka yami, loatomoko nde nda Lokasa mbo— Itokuchaka Botingani, limɔ bɛkɔkɔ bitomelesomoko mya.
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’ Zechariah 13:7

lokele: Kongo ko mbisa ya litɛmwi liami, itoetel’ino oso konda Ngalilai.
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ango batotina bekwaka se, nde inga to imi.
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wewe, isoonga laɛ mbo louse, ko e-bocho-bo, oso ani kɔkɔ ekati lɔkɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈ bata bambale, aɛ nd’atoanganya’mi banganya basatɔ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

lokele: Petelo loongaka la ofoka mbo— Loengana nde mbo iweke laɛ, ambo itianganyëkë Aɛ. La iyo batotina loonga ko ongoma. Elanga ya Ngetesemane
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

lokele: Iyo loiya nda elela, lina lia yao liko Ngetesemane, la Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo— Yalaka se ono ani Imi itosombola.
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

lokele: Yesu lotolana la Petelo la Yakobo la Yoane amamwito; Inde loakola ndoilima la ikɛnɛnɛ la lɔtɔtɔngɔ,
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Botema wami bosowaa l’ikɛnɛnɛ showa, tatikalaka eya la lambaka.
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ oso sinyo, Inde lokwa se nda nyɛlɛ, Inde losombokola mbo mbile-ye ekɔkɔlɔkɔ ndoeteel’Inde fwa.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

lokele: Inde mbo— Aba, Sango, otokɔkɔlɔ bitoti, sokoelaka’mi e-kɔpɔ-ye, nde tinga lisangi liami, kangä eliaɛ likelomoko.
english: He said, “Abba, 14:36 Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

lokele: Inde loya, Inde loosh’iyo ani batoingala tɔlɔ, Inde loonga la Petelo mbo— ¿Simona, osoingala? Otilonge ndolamba ko saa ɛmwito?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

lokele: Lambaka la sombolaka mbo otaɔtɔ nda lisoshela; botema nde bosokimela, kongo ko bindo bile la bɔlɛmbu.
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ liasi okasombola ko la baoi ebaongiki Inde oso,
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

lokele: Inde loya liasi, Inde loosh’iyo basoingala tɔlɔ eoka baiso bau baaka la bolengelenge la batialuwäkä omutoel’Inde.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

lokele: La Inde loya liya lia asatɔ, Inde mbo— Ingalakaka to, taɛumaka… Engani, saa esoya; Tɛnɛ, Wana wa oto akowambomo nda besamba ya bato abe.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

lokele: Emalaka, tɔɛkɛ. Inde oyatowamba’mi ale oko tina. Liwambomu la liundomu lia Yesu
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

lokele: Aaka Inde atoonga, kwaamao, Yudasi loya, ɔmɔi wa eba liu la ambale, la amamwito lande windi wa bato la chaka la totumbe ebasokwaka ende kanga ebieti la batikasa la biange.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

lokele: Inde oyawambi Yesu nd’afaka iyo ndembe oso mbo— Boto oyatota’mi et’inde ichou, ambo inde-yo; undesaka inde, kɛndɛkɛ lande la wɛlï.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

lokele: Ayaka Yudasi, inde lɔkɛ mangu ende Yesu, inde mbo— Boekesi, la afak’inde ichɔu.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

lokele: Iyo loundes’Inde la besamba yau, iyo lɔkɛ lande.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

lokele: Kongo ko ɔmɔi wa ebaaka omao, inde lɔɔmɔlo ambɔtɛ, inde loswa bɔkɔwa wa kanga eyeti, inde lotinya inde litoi.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Osoyaundesa’mi la chaka la totumbe, kwa mbo yende wiya.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

lokele: Lise la lise ayaliki’mi lanu, nda ndakɔ ya Mungu aekesiki’mi ino, otiundese’mi; kongo ko ebiatomoko nda Lokasa loa Mungu bikɔchɔmɔkɔ.
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

lokele: Batotina lomach’Inde, iyo lolɔmwaka.
english: They all left him, and fled.

lokele: Kongo ko isenge simɔi lokɛsɛnɛ lande, oyalingelaka esinda efufu nda bindo, iyo lokota ndoundes’inde imɔ,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

lokele: nde inde lomacha esinda, inde lolɔmwa wase. Yesu oso wa Ikumbɛ sha BaYuda
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lɔkɛsɛ Yesu ende kanga eyeti la kanga la biange la batikasa losɔngɔmɔ omao.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

lokele: Petelo lotuta Yesu ko esika, inde lɔɔtɔ lɔ̈mbɔ loa kanga eyeti konda balɛlɛ la inde loyala se omao amamwito la betingani, inde lɔɔtɔ bösä.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

lokele: Bakanga la batotina ba ikumbɛ loluka itɔmbɔ mbo boleke Yesu nde batiɛnɛkɛ;
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

lokele: eoka bato wike lowanjel’Inde nde bawanjeli bau angosangana.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

lokele: Nde bamɔi loemala owanjel’Inde mbo— Iso tokaka Inde atoonga mbo—
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

lokele: Imi nd’atomelesa Ndakɔ-ye ya Mungu eyakelomoko la besamba ya bato, limɔ nda becho isatɔ, itoswa yasi eyetikelomo la besamba.
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

lokele: Kongo ko anyo imɔ bawanjeli bau angosangana.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

lokele: Lamao kanga eyeti loemala atiteni ya ikumbɛ, inde lofela Yesu mbo— ¿Otiamutole ango lioi? Tɔtɔmbɔ etosoya l’ebato-ba twende moni?
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

lokele: Nde Yesu loyalaka tau angomutola lioi. Limɔ kanga eyeti lofel’Inde liasi mbo— ¿Aɛ wende Masiya, wana wa Oyainelomu?
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Yende ongoma, la wɛnɛkɛ Wana wa oto atoyalaka se nda bosamba w’olome wa Bofoka l’ani atoya nda bafita ba use.
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

lokele: Limɔ kanga eyeti losalaka bisinda yande, inde mbo— ¿Tolukeke tɔtɔmbɔ twasi eok’iye?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

lokele: Ino osooka inde asosɛɔlɔ Mungu, likomyi lianu lile moni? Iyo yaatotina lof’Inde se mbo engani ndowa.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

lokele: Bamɔi loakola ndochwɛlɛ Inde sɔi la ndolinja bɔmbɔ wande la ndoom’Inde toku la ndoonga lande mbo— Tatɔndɔlɔkɔ. Limɔ betingani loundes’Inde, iyo loomak’Inde mbaka. Lianganyi lia Petelo
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

lokele: Ayalaka Petelo lousa nda balɛlɛ, bosali ɔmɔi boseka wa kanga eyeti loya end’inde la
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

lokele: ɛnɛk’inde ani Petelo atɔɔtɔ bösä, inde lotichak’inde la wɛlï limɔ inde mbo— Aɛ imɔ oyaliki amamwito la ewa Nasalene ako Yesu.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

lokele: Nde Petelo loanganya, inde mbo— Itiluwe Inde la itiluwe elosoong’aɛ. Limɔ inde lokuswa konda ɛɔtɛlɔ ya ndakɔ limɔ kɔkɔ lota lokɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

lokele: La boseka lɔɛnɛ inde liasi la inde loakola ndoonga la ebaemalaka omao mbo— Oyo ende ɔmɔi wau.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

lokele: La Petelo loanganya imɔ liasi, la mbisa ya mbile sinyo ebemali omao loonga la Petelo mbo— Wewe, wende ɔmɔi wau, eoka wende imɔ wa Ngalilai.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

lokele: Limɔ inde loakola ndosenda bieo la ndotinya ekano mbo— Itiluwe oto-yo oyatoongel’ino.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

lokele: Limɔ kɔkɔ lota lokɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈ lita lia ambale la Petelo loenyela lioi eliaongaka Yesu mbo— Oso ani kɔkɔ ekati lokɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈ bata bambale otoanganya’mi banganya basatɔ. Limɔ aenyelaka Petelo ongoma, inde lolelaka.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

lokele: Aaka bonyanya bososɔswa, lisasaya kanga ebieti la biange la batikasa iyo lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ, iyo lokanda Yesu, iyo lɔkɛ lande mbo bamachek’Inde nda besamba ya Pilato.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

lokele: Pilato lofela Yesu mbo— ¿Aɛ wende Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda? Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Aɛ nd’aongi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

lokele: Kanga ebieti lowanjakel’Inde bawanjeli wike;
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

lokele: limɔ Pilato lofel’Inde liasi mbo— ¿Otimutole ango lioi? Toka, bawanjeli wike ebatowanjel’iyo Aɛ.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

lokele: Nde Yesu angomutola ango sinyo imɔ, la ongoma Pilato lomwaala finɛ.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

lokele: Nda lise lia Elambɔ, Pilato ayalaka la boyaeli wofaikoela boto ɔmɔi wa ebakandomu kwa akalɛmbɛkɛ iyo angɛnɛ.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

lokele: Oto ɔmɔi lina liande liko Balaba, akandomuku amamwito la ebachwakaka kuko ya bita la ebaolaka bato.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

lokele: Windi wa bato loya ndoyafelaka Pilato mbo akeelek’iyo kwa akelakaka inde oso.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

lokele: Inde lomutol’iyo mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo ifaikoeleke ino Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda?
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

lokele: eoka Pilato lolembeela mbo kanga ebieti basoesha Yesu nda likomyi ko l’eoka ya lisiela kongo.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

lokele: Kongo ko kanga ebieti lofumbesa bato mbo afaikoelek’iyo ko Balaba.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

lokele: Pilato lomutoel’iyo liasi mbo— ¿ikeleke to moni la boto oyasotangomo lanu mbo Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda?
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

lokele: Iyo loanjanja liasi mbo— Olaka’Inde nda lieka.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

lokele: Pilato mbo— Eoka iye? ¿Boni obe ebosokel’Inde? Kongo ko iyo loanjanja likama liasi mbo— Olak’Inde nda lieka.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

lokele: Limɔ Pilato losɔmbɔɛl’iyo Balaba, eoka alɛmbɛkɛ ndoomalesa windi wa bato. Limɔ ani Yesu asoomakomo fimbo, Pilato lɔkɛsɛ Inde nda liwa nda lieka.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

lokele: Basilikani ba Pilato lɔkɛ la Yesu nda lɔmbɔ loa ndakɔ yau, lamao iyo lota botükä wau bototina,
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

lokele: iyo lowates’Inde esinda etelu limɔ iyo lotaka likala lia kɛ̈kɛ̈ iyo lotel’Inde liao nda otö,
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

lokele: iyo lolamokol’Inde mbo— Ho, Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda.
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

lokele: Iyo looma botö wande la isosola, iyo lochwɛlɛ Inde sɔi, iyo loswel’Inde balui se kwa lisemoli.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

lokele: Limɔ asilak’iyo ndot’Inde kungutu, iyo losokoel’Inde esinda etelu, iyo lowates’Inde esinda yande angɛnɛ, limɔ iyo loumes’Inde okaol’Inde nda lieka. Liwa nda Lieka
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

lokele: Iyo loundesa oto ɔmɔi ako Simona wa Kulene ani atosekwa nda bilanga, iyo lotoles’inde lieka lia Yesu. (Oto ona aaka sango wa Alesandelo la Lufu.)
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

lokele: Iyo loesha Yesu nda elela eyatomoko mbo Ngolongota, litina mbo:— Longö-loa-otö.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

lokele: Lamao iyo lotamb’Inde bänä ebabuyani la lisoo mbo amweke nde atiɔsɛ bao.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

lokele: Iyo loanyemes’Inde nda lieka limɔ iyo lokaana esinda yande ko ndota ngongo nda likao elikaɔlɛkɛ oto la oto.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

lokele: Buse wiyelaka bonyanya booku ani baanyemesaka Yesu nda lieka.
english: It was the third hour 15:25 when they crucified him.

lokele: Loasɔ elosowanjelomo Inde losɔnɔmu nda lionga mbo— Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

lokele: Baanyemesaka eba beoni lisanga amamwito lande, ɔmɔi nda bosamba wa olome la oyɔmɔi nda ewa wali.…
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

lokele: Ebetaka losungakel’Inde, iyo lofilingakel’Inde betö, iyo mbo— Aha, oyatomelesa Ndakɔ ya Mungu koswa liasi ko la becho isatɔ,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

lokele: uwesaka lokomba loaɛ angɛnɛ, sokwaka nda lieka.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

lokele: Imɔ ko kanga ebieti lolimbokol’Inde la batikasa lisanga, iyo mbo— Auwekesäkä basi, atikɔkɔlɛ ndouwesa lokomba loande angɛnɛ;
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

lokele: Masiya Bɔkɔta wa Isalaele asokweke nda lieka, mbo twɛnɛkɛ la toimeleke. La ebaanyemesomoko lande iyo imɔ lolimbol’Inde.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” 15:32 Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

lokele: Ayaka buse ifitika, lilima lokwa nda yese etotina konda lilongolongo.
english: When the sixth hour 15:33 had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour. 15:33

lokele: Lamao nda lilongolongo Yesu lota limiki lifi, Inde mbo— Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakatani? Litina mbo, ¿Mungu wami, Mungu wami, moni osomacha’mi booi?
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” Psalms 22:1

lokele: Bamɔi ebaemalaka ina, iyo looka, iyo mbo— Toka, asota Eliya lioi; la ɔmɔi lokwa mangu okafɔɛsɛ lilamba nda bänä, inde lota liao nda ifende, inde lof’Inde amweke; la inde loonga mbo— Macha, twɛnɛkɛ ango Eliya ataya oyasokol’Inde omao.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lota limiki lifi, Inde lokusola luli nda liwa.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

lokele: Esinda ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu losalya yaki imbale, ko likolo ko se.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Komanda wa basilikani oyaemaelaka tina la Yesu, ani asokwel’Inde se, inde mbo— Fufo, boto’yo ende ngo Wana wa Mungu.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

lokele: Batomali baaka esika sumbu otichaka elokelomu, bako Malia wa Mangandala, la Malia nyango wa Yakobo, oyo ɔkɛkɛ, la ewa Yose, la Salome, la basi
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

lokele: ebatutaka Yesu la ebatinganaka lande ani akɛndɛlɛkɛ Inde Ngalilai la batomali basi imɔ ebayiki nda Yelusaleme amamwito lande. Liombomu lia Yesu
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

lokele: Iyaka buse litele, eoka mbo wende buse wotonja lise lia Yenga,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

lokele: oto ɔmɔi ako Yosefa wa Alimataya, oyaaka wolitesomo wa ikumbɛ la oyalukaka loyo loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, oto-ao lɔkɛ la lotendela ende Pilato okaömba bolyo wa Yesu.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

lokele: Nde Pilato lomwaala mbo asotakwela se, inde lota Komanda lioi, inde lofel’inde ango asosila ndowa.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

lokele: Aluwesomökö inde ongoma ende Komanda, Pilato lofaefa Yosefa bolyo wa Yesu.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

lokele: Inde losomba bisinda bifufu; asulolak’inde bolyo wa Yesu se, inde lolingela Inde la bisinda, limɔ inde loinges’Inde nda losai eloafuwomökö nda batalɛ, la inde loundukokola litalɛ lifi liolinja ɛɔtɛlɔ ya losai.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

lokele: Malia wa Mangandala la Malia nyango wa Yose loticha elela olo aingesomökö Inde.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

lokele: Etaka lise lia osambale (Yenga ya BaYuda) Malia wa Mangandala la Malia nyango wa Yakobo, la otomali ako Salome, iyo losomba tuma twa liɛsɛ mbo baɛkɛ okalɔɔkɛsɛ bolyo wa Yesu.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

lokele: Lanɔngɔnɔngɔ la lise lia oso lia Yenga la yombe, iyo loya nda losai.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

lokele: Nda mboka iyo loonganaka mbo— ¿Ndai to atoundukolel’iso litalɛ nda ɛɔtɛlɔ ya losai?
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

lokele: Atichak’iyo losai, iyo lɔɛnɛ oko litalɛ lisoundukolomo, liaaka nde litalɛ lifi fafo.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

lokele: Ɔtɔkɔ iyo nda losai iyo lɔɛnɛ isenge oyawati esinda efufu ani ayali se nda faki y’olome, la batomali lotalimwa finɛ.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Otalimwëke. Otoluka nde Yesu wa Nasaleta oyaolomu nda lieka, nde asoemala liasi; at’imɔ eyamaya. Tɛnɛkɛ elela eyaingesomu Inde.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

lokele: Nde kɛndɛkɛ okakambesa baeki bande la Petelo lisanga mbo asotakɛ oso wanu nda Ngalilai, wɛnɛkɛ nde Inde omao kwa aongaka Inde lanu.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

lokele: Limɔ batomali lokuswaka nda losai ani bakwaka mangu eoka iyo lonyanga la liyaimweso fafo. Batiaongaka ango lioi la oto angɔmɔi eoka bawangaka nde.…
english: They went out, 16:8 and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid. 16:8 They told all that had been commanded them briefly to those around Peter. After that, Jesus himself sent them out, from east to west, with the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation.

lokele: (Akuswaka Inde lanɔngɔnɔngɔ la lise lia oso lia Yenga, Inde lɔɛnɛlɛ oso ende Malia wa Mangandala oyakusola Yesu ekusol’inde belimo ibe osambale. Malia lɔkɛ okakambesa ebayalanaka la Yesu oso, ani basowel’Inde la lileli.
english: 16:9 Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

lokele: Nde okaka iyo baoi-ba mbo Yesu akoyali liasi la mbo Malia asɔɛnɛ Inde, iyo angoimela.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

lokele: La mbisa, Inde lɔɛnɛlɛ la wɛnɛɛli wasi ende bambale bau nda mboka ani batɔkɛ nda bilanga.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loinywa okakambesa ebamɔi ebatikaläkä, kongo ko iyo imɔ angoimela.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

lokele: Mbisa lamao Inde lɔɛnɛlɛ ende eba liu la ɔmɔi ani bayaläkä nda mɛsa. La Yesu loima iyo eoka ya fee la betema bewaü eoka batiaimeläkä bato ebɛnɛk’Inde mbisa ya litɛmwi liande.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda wenda bototina, okataka Mboli Ilau ende bato batotina ebale la liwawi.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

lokele: Oyatoimela la atolufiomo, oyo nd’atouwesomo, nde oyaitoimela atofomo se.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

lokele: Ndembe ya tokesa bitotutana la ebatoimela, biko, batokusola belimo ibe nda lina liami; batoonga baoi bayai; batoilaka njɔ;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

lokele: ango bemwa lisäkä iyo angowa; batotalia besamba yau ende eba kambo, limɔ iyo kosäsa sasosaso.
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

lokele: Ongoma, mbisa ani Ngɛnɛ Yesu asoongana lau, Inde loilomo nda Use, Inde loyala se nda faki ya olome ya Mungu. Nde iyo loilaka kɛndɔ okataka Mboli nda fangi bitotina, la Ngɛnɛ lokelanaka lau likuwa la Inde lokɔkɔmɛsɛ Mboli ko la ndembe eyatutakanaka.)
english: So then the Lord, 16:19 after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
